Hey there,
**The U.S. Senate is a country club.** It’s full of millionaires, former business execs, lawyers with Ivy League degrees, and trust fund kids born with so many silver spoons in their mouths that they have no idea the reality for working-class people like me.
**If I defeat my opponent Republican Senator Deb Fischer in November, I will be the poorest member of the U.S. Senate.** I don’t come from money, and I’m not rich. I’m a steamfitter and mechanic who works 50 and 60 hour weeks to give my kids a better life.
**I will be the only senator without a college degree.** After my wife and I found out we were expecting a baby, I had to drop out and kill my dream of hanging a diploma on the wall because my family needed health insurance, diapers, and food on the table.
**I will be the only senator who is a blue-collar, card-carrying, union member.** When Kellogg’s tried to cut our benefits and workers’ pay, we risked it all, went on strike, and walked the picket line for 11 weeks through the bitter cold Nebraska winter. We won and saved hundreds of good-paying jobs – before I was fired for being the union president who led the strike.
There is no one who represents working-class people like me in the U.S. Senate. Which is why this is such big news: **Four brand-new polls show I am narrowly LEADING my opponent Republican Senator Deb Fischer. And FiveThirtyEight now says this is the CLOSEST Senate race in the entire country!**

Implementation of last year’s referendum protecting abortion hangs in the balance, which some 57% of Ohioans voted for. clean_body: Winning pro-democracy races in Ohio is critical to pushing back against election-denying extremists | To: NDRC “Team Ohio” Re: Early vote update Today Peter, Ohio is open for early voting , and voters in small towns and big cities all across the state are heading into polling booths and casting their ballots in this pivotal election. The stakes couldn’t be higher in Ohio this year, which is why the NDRC is laser-focused on electing our Democracy Defenders. = 🗳️ First day of early voting: TODAY , Oct 8th 📩 Last day to request a ballot by mail (received, not postmarked): Tuesday, Oct 29th 🙋 Last day of in-person early voting: Sunday, Nov 3rd 🇺🇸 Election Day: Tuesday, Nov 5th Fair, Independent State Supreme Court We know all too well how an extremist Supreme Court at the federal level can have grave impacts on our rights and liberties. This election, Ohio’s Supreme Court will have tremendous sway over whether the courts protect fundamental rights, adhere to legal and judicial norms, and uphold the rule of all for all Ohioans. Here’s why: The GOP’s majority on this court is just a narrow 4-3, but it became more conservative last year with the retirement of a moderate Republican — and the appointment of a conservative prosecutor. Three seats are on the ballot this year, two held by Democrats and one by the GOP, so the court could shift in either direction. If Republicans sweep the election, they’ll have a 6-1 majority in 2025. We can't let that happen, Peter. = Three Races Will Impact the Rights & Lives of Ohioans The stakes couldn’t be higher when it comes to securing a pro-democracy majority on the Ohio Supreme Court. Implementation of last year’s referendum protecting abortion hangs in the balance, which some 57% of Ohioans voted for. A wide variety of anti-abortion laws still remain on the books, and will be litigated in cases that will wind up at the Ohio Supreme Court. Several redistricting cases are expected to land on the docket of the Supreme Court in the next couple of years — and those decisions will impact how Ohioans vote for years, even decades to come. Put simply, Ohio is a key state in our strategy to change the trajectory of democracy in November. Electing Justice Donnelly, Justice Stewart, and Judge Forbes to the Ohio Supreme Court is essential to making sure we have a balanced, independent, and fair-minded court. = Thank you, Team NDRC | = = Since 2017, the NDRC has executed a comprehensive redistricting strategy that shifts the redistricting power, creating fair districts where Democrats can compete. name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: The return of Betsy Devos
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2047%2E135344%2E15mwPD)

Friend -
If you were waiting for the perfect time to make your first donation to my campaign for Senate, not only is today the perfect day but there's also a very good reason as well.
Betsy DeVos.
If you're already familiar with her significant support for my opponent and are ready to chip in, please use this link to give:
**[https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/beat-devos](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241011-4-900&t=2&akid=2047%2E135344%2E15mwPD)**
Otherwise, let me go a little deeper ... including a very recent revelation about her designs on a role in a second Trump administration.
As Michiganders know, for decades the DeVos family’s #1 issue has been weakening Michigan's, and the country's, public education system. Betsy DeVos used Michigan as her petri dish before becoming Trump’s Secretary of Education, and one of his longest serving cabinet secretaries.
Much like our Republican opponent, Mike Rogers, she condemned Donald Trump after January 6, 2021. In Betsy DeVos’ case, she “resigned in protest” as Education Secretary, blaming his rhetoric on the insurrection -- just 13 days before the end of Trump’s term.
And like my current opponent who turned around and worked hard for Trump's endorsement, Betsy DeVos is now back -- and willing to serve in a second Trump administration.
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241011-4-900&t=3&akid=2047%2E135344%2E15mwPD)
So what does that mean?
As if there weren't already a million reasons to defeat Donald Trump, there's now one more: keeping Betsy DeVos out of any role of prominence in Washington, D.C.
And there is no doing that without winning in Michigan.
The DeVos family has been some of the top supporters to opponents of mine in the past, and they've doubled down on this Senate race.
Mike Rogers' first FEC report in this race was filled with donations from a bunch of members of the DeVos family -- contributions totaling $46,200 all made on one single day. Just a day before our primary election in August, Betsy DeVos herself was campaigning with Mike Rogers at a roundtable.
They are certainly not done with their support of my opponent.
On a positive note, the response to emails about the DeVos donations has raised far more than the DeVos family has contributed. But we have to keep going, because their family's unlimited wealth can impact this race in many more ways.
So in light of this news about Betsy DeVos' potential return to Washington, D.C. and her role in campaigning for my opponent, I am asking:
[**Can you contribute $3 directly to my campaign for U.S. Senate in Michigan before our FEC deadline in a few days? I will put your donation made today in Betsy’s name right to work persuading the voters we need to win in Michigan this fall.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241011-4-900&t=4&akid=2047%2E135344%2E15mwPD)

From _The Civil War_ to _The Central Park Five, The Dust Bowl_ or _Defying the Nazis_ — in these moments, we had to decide whether or not we'd live up to the essential promise of our nation: a democracy that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
**And 24 days from now, America will decide once more.** We're faced with two options: one that focuses on a brighter future that lives up to that promise, and another that prefers a past where it was too often retracted.
But this choice won't only be made when we select our next president. It's one we'll make in every race, up and down the ballot in every state.

As the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and a tireless advocate for her community, to me, she reflects the realization of the American Dream and democratic values that I encourage us all to uphold. More than that: I trust her to keep our nation on the path of progress, where our nation's essential promise is extended to us all, in the U.S. Senate. I cannot say the same for her opponent, Rick Scott — someone whose positions, policies, and personality all point to the darkest departures from that promise: The grifts of the Gilded Age. The manic paranoia of the (original) McCarthy era. The relentless injustice of Reconstruction. So I'm reaching out to you now, Peter, because Florida must now decide which path to follow. And in a race that could decide Senate control, Florida's choice could shape the next chapter of our story. Fortunately, the polls seem to indicate the tides are turning toward the path of righteousness that Debbie embodies. But another lesson history teaches us is that money talks. So against an opponent who wields our story to selfish ends, with enough wealth to blanket the airwaves with lies from now to Election Day, it's on all of us to ensure Debbie has the resources to rise above the noise, starting by reaching her $150,000 daily goal. If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: We the people are about to make history. I hope you'll join us on the right side. Thank you, Ken Burns Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri

body:
Fellow Conservative,

It's Ted Cruz.

You know me.

You know I'm a freedom fighter, a defender of liberty, and an advocate for a smaller, more effective federal government.

You probably don't know this man, former U.S. Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy; you should familiarize yourself with his name and mission to be Montana's next United States Senator.

******************************************************[Chip in any amount ->](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/SCfNhHtd9CdakG4JVoTbCg~~/AAVLBgA~/RgRo7jzkP0T1aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9ucnNjL3NoZWVoeS1mYW1pbGlhcml6ZS15b3Vyc2VsZi10cy1hZWRnZS8_dXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fc291cmNlPWFlZGdlX25yc2NfTU1NJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI0MDkyM19uYV9zaGVlaHlmYW1pbGlhcml6ZXlvdXJzZWxmLXRjLXYxX01NTV90Y3J1el9ucnNjJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PWZ1bmRyYWlzaW5nJmFtdHBvc2l0aW9uPTQmYW10ND0xMDAmcmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWVXA3NwY0IKZwUoJgtnaeAxwVIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)******************************************************

If Republicans do not do everything in our power to help Tim Sheehy defeat Jon Tester in Montana, we will not be able to capture the Senate majority in November.

That's just a fact.

While I'm grateful that conservatives like you open emails like this one, I'd be even more thankful if you took the next step and made a financial contribution to Tim Sheehy's U.S. Senate campaign right now.

******************************************************[Donate to Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy->](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/SCfNhHtd9CdakG4JVoTbCg~~/AAVLBgA~/RgRo7jzkP0T1aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9ucnNjL3NoZWVoeS1mYW1pbGlhcml6ZS15b3Vyc2VsZi10cy1hZWRnZS8_dXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fc291cmNlPWFlZGdlX25yc2NfTU1NJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI0MDkyM19uYV9zaGVlaHlmYW1pbGlhcml6ZXlvdXJzZWxmLXRjLXYxX01NTV90Y3J1el9ucnNjJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PWZ1bmRyYWlzaW5nJmFtdHBvc2l0aW9uPTQmYW10ND0xMDAmcmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWVXA3NwY0IKZwUoJgtnaeAxwVIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)******************************************************

Not ready to donate yet? Ok, Here are a couple of reasons I'm PROUD to endorse Tim Sheehy in what is shaping up to be a VERY costly and VERY competitive Senate race in Montana. Generational change: Tim's opponent is running for a FOURTH six-year term in the Senate. What can Jon Tester do with another six years in the Senate that he couldn't accomplish in the previous 18?

Transparency: As far as I'm aware, few Americans support elected officials beholden to lobbyists and special interest groups. Tim's opponent is the largest recipient of lobbyist dollars in the United States Senate.

Service: As a former Navy SEAL and recipient of a Purple Heart and Bronze Star medal, Tim truly knows what it means to put his country first. Veterans make the best public servants; bravery and honor are not things someone can teach.

Tim's race in Montana will likely be one of, if not the most expensive, Senate races this year. When I tell you that you cannot afford to refrain from contributing to this American Hero, I mean it.

******************************************************[Donate to Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy->](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/SCfNhHtd9CdakG4JVoTbCg~~/AAVLBgA~/RgRo7jzkP0T1aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9ucnNjL3NoZWVoeS1mYW1pbGlhcml6ZS15b3Vyc2VsZi10cy1hZWRnZS8_dXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fc291cmNlPWFlZGdlX25yc2NfTU1NJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI0MDkyM19uYV9zaGVlaHlmYW1pbGlhcml6ZXlvdXJzZWxmLXRjLXYxX01NTV90Y3J1el9ucnNjJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PWZ1bmRyYWlzaW5nJmFtdHBvc2l0aW9uPTQmYW10ND0xMDAmcmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWVXA3NwY0IKZwUoJgtnaeAxwVIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)******************************************************

If you want more of the same, then by all means, ignore me, this email, and my request for your assistance.

But having been in the Senate for several years now, I know a couple of things to be true: Democrats cannot do the math. They have no concept of money, what it costs the average American to live, or how to balance a budget. Spending more than you make is a recipe for DISASTER.

Democrats don't understand geography. Despite countless Republican efforts to help them understand the concept of borders, they can't seem to grasp the idea of national sovereignty. Heck, since Joe Biden moved into the White House in 2021, more than 10 million illegal migrants have crossed our "border" illegally.

Democrats fail to understand that religious zealots want us all DEAD. From calling for cease-fires with terrorists to sending money to Iran in exchange for nothing but lies, Democrats have zero concept of what peace through strength means.

******************************************************[Donate to Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy->](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/SCfNhHtd9CdakG4JVoTbCg~~/AAVLBgA~/RgRo7jzkP0T1aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUud2lucmVkLmNvbS9ucnNjL3NoZWVoeS1mYW1pbGlhcml6ZS15b3Vyc2VsZi10cy1hZWRnZS8_dXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fc291cmNlPWFlZGdlX25yc2NfTU1NJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI0MDkyM19uYV9zaGVlaHlmYW1pbGlhcml6ZXlvdXJzZWxmLXRjLXYxX01NTV90Y3J1el9ucnNjJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PWZ1bmRyYWlzaW5nJmFtdHBvc2l0aW9uPTQmYW10ND0xMDAmcmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWVXA3NwY0IKZwUoJgtnaeAxwVIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)******************************************************

As you know, I am running for re-election to the Senate this year and can speak with some authority about what Americans seek in a leader. Tim Sheehy is already a leader, and now I need your help to make him a leader in the United States Senate.

I hope you'll stand with me today in support of this great American, former Navy SEAL, and future United States Senator, Tim Sheehy.

Respectfully,

clean_body: Do you approve of VP Kamala Harris? Friend: With Kamala Harris’ town hall behind us — and looking ahead to Donald Trump’s town hall — we urgently need to know where top Democrats stand just 23 days out from Election Day. But right now, we're still missing YOUR response. We need to hear from at least another 58grassroots supporters from 43614 before MIDNIGHT TONIGHT. So please, take a moment now to record your response: Do you approve of Vice President Kamala Harris? | | | | \---------- Forwarded message ---------- From: Team Gillibrand Subject: Did you watch the town hall? | | | Did you watch the town hall, friend? Kamala Harris has done it again. She's reminded us why she's the best person to lead our great country forward toward progress. She emphasized her commitment to EXPANDING affordable health care, RESTORING reproductive freedom and PROTECTING Social Security and Medicare — all in an effort to deliver more opportunities to Americans. With Election Day rapidly approaching and polls showing her locked in a dead heat with Donald Trump, we've randomly selected 325 Democrats in 43614 to let us know where they stand — and that includes you, friend! So before midnight tonight, tell us: Do you approve of Vice President Kamala Harris? | | | | | * | = A note from Kirsten: Friend, I can’t thank you enough for standing by my side in the critical fights ahead of us. As Democrats face our toughest Senate map in decades, I need your help more than ever. While Republicans only have to defend 10 seats in 2024, Democrats have to defend 23 — and if the GOP flips just two of them, it will deliver Senate control back to Mitch McConnell. Now, experts at FiveThirtyEight are saying that the GOP has a clear path to the majority. As right-wing special interests gear up to pour millions into flipping the Senate, we need to fight back right now. But I refuse to take a single cent from corporate PACs, which means I’m relying on your grassroots support. = And if you’d like to become a core member of my team and receive exclusive texts from my campaign, = Thank you, Kirsten Gillibrand

We are expecting another razor-thin election, so our strategy is to compete everywhere, expand the map, and maximize the number of pathways to victory so that we can win this election even if not every swing state goes our way. **[If that’s enough to convince you to sign up to start knocking doors or making calls to voters today, click here to find an event near you. If not, we hope you’ll keep reading this email.](https://click.contact.kamalaharris.com/ss/c/u001.xqm-apKpWqGuZCDDu9wrxR9IXPCsluZXFBWW-0djqjv8NGrLpGFeCwCxai8yNVOZCi1UMs54yXLShFOcrQUyc8OpbskxjvzhKknkIW4m-sNfYAWVltQfm_rA1yD1-nQp1CauBMceA861q1rIrGhZxNv0_bomos-jtkfNcN2FA-5RiF8WVRoHF0SaikyHwwmdF_p0MPxY_uQ5rCcqoQeO_UNIdam24y7Q9X8iBRc_y9f7pzfEC4usz8ClwrG6KBkYfF0zm0dv8oWDD-EQDZ7rFoDvWSrQL1S0la5M7HICrczRgl1J-VL7qSh0fagChAZu5mifAk_psI69k92MX2cwQADFA9T1k0o7aHy2mrzEihzCn6lcc7J7VDmNpELNwS8Y/4ak/pCqnIBd0Qxa8Qx6rlgnquQ/h1/h001.wpKITHlvZwxxxyX0qo_tjT1UniyEBSQBoZUA5fd4lJg)** _Right now, we’re at risk of falling short of the goals we need to hit in order to beat Donald Trump._ We set out this weekend with an ambitious goal of 800,000 doors knocked in key states like Pennsylvania. clean_body: Right now, we’re at risk of falling incredibly short of the goals we need to hit in order to beat Donald Trump. | | | You may have already noticed an uptick in emails from political candidates across the country saying that they need your help right now contacting voters if we want to defeat Donald Trump and elect Democrats up and down the ballot. They’re not wrong,Peter . A lot of these emails have even come from us. So, we want to pull back the curtain and tell you what all the urgency is about: We are effectively tied in the seven battleground states -- Pennsylvania, Michigan, Wisconsin, Nevada, Arizona, Georgia, and North Carolina. We are expecting another razor-thin election, so our strategy is to compete everywhere, expand the map, and maximize the number of pathways to victory so that we can win this election even if not every swing state goes our way. Right now, we’re at risk of falling short of the goals we need to hit in order to beat Donald Trump. We set out this weekend with an ambitious goal of 800,000 doors knocked in key states like Pennsylvania. We have not reached it yet. Without grassroots energy from this team, we could very easily lose this race and find ourselves facing another four years of Donald Trump. A Donald Trump that is more extreme than ever before. We cannot let it happen. We know that you support Kamala Harris and Tim Walz, and we could not be more appreciative. | | Not seeing an event that works for you? You can find more volunteer opportunities. We can’t reach our goal without you. Thank you for your support, Kamala HQ | | | |

## Trump's Polling Outperforming 2016, 2020
Former President Donald Trump is doing [better in the polls](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFyhCAURb8GOxx4groFRRq6TZvSQXy7vgyCA6zO_n3GpE5z5xSnOHO_7tPdUaD4_HQbmvpIk_OVDpyk4LLjoCbVLOaBCNg1aOQA4yhvANCsBmY1Cg9uBvRu0f0sle57r7R3gwOhGjIgQEkhOymkFNB63ckRUfcA7iYVMiVwoZpy-50o1hUf4Z0OzK1PWxPMWuteWPfBwDKw53m2r-JqWtz7EhjYUlN-M7ARz8LA7ilQJX8hBvSVUrz4imBgpbgG_rxQeM2vbedH4avLmQqfacHIfaBYU2RgB607UGoUYmBgm2yW_aQQqPQDU-K5OQq_nfWf2w4DPwEAAP__zGJs_g) than he was at this time four years ago and when he won the White House in 2016. Although Trump trails Democratic nominee Kamala Harris in most polls, he is behind by smaller margins than he faced in the other two elections, opening the possibility that voters who quietly support Trump will defy the poll results on Nov. 5. By contrast, RealClearPolling's[ average of polls](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0z71urDAQQOGngc7IMzZ_hYvbbLe3TYlmYVgmO-CVsbDy9lHSpz_S0fdxn-4kKsfzP-0c8honmrNcPIE14Az6yddLWJmRXc0BehwGGBGx3gIO1K0DOk-PHhGAxtW27TLMztlH27paAlr0YMGBBbDYzK2DgbntEGkEz5W3vEiOqfmMcuSNV_2KF6dmjnutYcv5fVbuX4W3Cm-llObgchbm109Q4e1FOymZjVKS07yjqlGmxeREoqd5yMKHmVWOHA8DY9f7EesUlncRVTm7vvL2uZPo7zD_4b8CfgcAAP__CoJcmg) shows Harris's 1.8 point lead over Trump lags behind the 10.3 point lead that President Biden enjoyed on Oct. 10, 2020.
## Whooping Cough Makes Comeback
Whooping cough cases are [up by 340% over last year,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LFugzAQxvGnwZuR7-zYZPDQJVu6dkQXOLArgxF2QvP2Fd07_6Tvk_5f9_5OMcV1_qSFfZ1yT0ONL-5BSdASTW_E6CdmZC3Yg8OugysiiuA767QdwT7IwYUA2emHY7AWlOlIoYgeFRpQoEEBKGyHi4aO-WIR6QqGG6N4jDXv7XeOaw08pXd-8d4OeRHJh1q30uiPBm8N3o7jaKf8s_JRTm_wFphSDSeFnLe4znLIzznIgQoX-dzkkneWNdAqz1VZ48IyUanyzbSL3Y_bEVOKxbrGqHmhmP6e6z8hXh5_AwAA__-LkmDh) according to the U.S Centers for Disease Control. The infectious respiratory disease, known formally as pertussis, is especially harmful to babies younger than a year old. It gets its name from a high-pitched "whoop" sound from the severe coughing fits it causes. Some scientists believe [masking and other anti-COVID measures](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFuwyAQQL8GNiLuwIk9MHTxlq4drSs-m6tIsAxJ5L-vmr3re8OT3td1upJkua-fdOPQljJRbPLkCawBZ9BPXs9hYUZ2mgNcsO9hQESdAg-975c5ItrBdt1AZ9vNnhyBw2_onZaAFj1YcGABLJ5i56Bn7s6INIBn5S3P0sp--ilyb4mXfJQn76dYbjqH1NpWlftQOCocW-IkOf85heNWssRD4ZiYckuRdlY4-sFZsGheqZRN7quJ5bEmE6lyNfWxr282R1PpqApHvYd5e0nOUs8X5e16I3kXdPtnxjPgbwAAAP__ie5geg) caused the decline in recent years. But those numbers have since reversed. Whooping cough can be treated with antibiotics. Children get protection through standard rounds of vaccinations once they are old enough, and the vaccine combinations are also available for adults.
## List: America's Most Haunted Hotels
Travelers looking for spooky thrills this Halloween season have plenty to choose from among the nation's many haunted hotels. [This list highlights the most ghost-ridden hotels](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0j7FurEAMAL9m6UC2lzug2OI1dPfalMiw5nC0sCdwQPn7KNenH81oPh7DgzXp9vzPqwSb88CT6SkDQom-pHqoixhmERJfSMCG2hY7IiqWAMgeRoBmjlMnvo2xud9YZBwnGKVtCg0EVCOgR0AEqqabx1bkdifiDmtxNUhUy3v1mXWzReb0nU_ZqymvRQqL2etw_p-j3lF_XVdly64p6WG_hKPedj4lOeo3Ns2bo37Nh5ULf20msVyySTpK3UpeZdeJiz3E1_VW3BtXw3NlTe-a_TF_BvoJAAD__zMPXdM) in every state in America. They range from the obvious, like _The Stanley_ in Colorado's Estes Park, the inspiration for Stephen King's "The Shining," to the unusual, such as the _Hotel Provincial_ in New Orleans, where legend says you can call the ghost of Confederate General P.G.T. Beauregard simply by saying "Shiloh" at 2 a.m. Creepiest of all might be the _Colonial Inn_ in Concord, Mass., a 300-year-old former former hospital for colonial soldiers. You can stay in Room 24, the old operating room, or even Room 27, the former home of the morgue. [See the full list for all 50 states here.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0j7FurEAMAL9m6UC2lzug2OI1dPfalMiw5nC0sCdwQPn7KNenH81oPh7DgzXp9vzPqwSb88CT6SkDQom-pHqoixhmERJfSMCG2hY7IiqWAMgeRoBmjlMnvo2xud9YZBwnGKVtCg0EVCOgR0AEqqabx1bkdifiDmtxNUhUy3v1mXWzReb0nU_ZqymvRQqL2etw_p-j3lF_XVdly64p6WG_hKPedj4lOeo3Ns2bo37Nh5ULf20msVyySTpK3UpeZdeJiz3E1_VW3BtXw3NlTe-a_TF_BvoJAAD__zMPXdM)

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Some things to remember in the next few weeks
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
We’ve also got to remember what we’re up against.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2369%2E4032634%2EMdKyY5)
---
For the next few weeks, while we have our heads down doing everything possible to elect Democrats up and down the ticket, I also want us to picture the finish line. I want us to remember _what_ we’re fighting for — because when the fight gets hard, that’s what’ll keep us going. Just think about the vision that Vice President Kamala Harris has laid out for an economy that works for working people, including...
* Taking on giant corporations that engage in price-gouging
* Bringing down housing costs by building 3 million new units
* Cutting costs for child care and prescription drugs, including extending the $35/month cap on insulin prices to all Americans
* Providing tax cuts to over 100 million working-class and middle-class Americans
* Strengthening Social Security and Medicare, including a new plan to cover in-home health care under Medicare, which will be truly life-changing for generations and generations of families to come
* Rolling back Donald Trump’s tax cuts for the rich and putting a minimum tax on billionaires so they pay a fair share

With Kamala Harris and Tim Walz in the White House, and Democrats controlling the U.S. House and Senate, we can make real change for working people. We can protect our freedoms, including the right to an abortion and the right to vote. We can build a future not just for some of our kids, but all of our kids. **I’m running for re-election to the U.S. Senate so I can keep fighting to build that future** — including with my plans to lower housing costs, ensure universal child care, and root out corruption in Washington. I’ve fought my entire career to make our economy fairer for the middle class, from taking on big banks to make the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau a reality to breaking up the hearing aid monopoly to lower costs for families. And I’m not stopping. But we’ve also got to remember what we’re up against. Donald Trump’s big legislative accomplishment was a set of massive tax breaks for billionaires and giant corporations. And as Trump is courting wealthy donors for his 2024 campaign, he’s promising them even more tax handouts in return. Giant corporations are going in on the deal, too, loading up Republican campaign accounts with cash with the expectation that they’ll get even more tax cuts. And it just so happens that Trump's planned tax cuts would give the largest corporations an estimated $48 billion break. While Trump and the Republicans fight to make rich and powerful people and companies even more rich and powerful, I'll keep fighting alongside Kamala Harris to get the wealthy and well-connected to pay a fair share — so we can expand opportunity for all. We’ve already started to tackle this by passing my minimum tax on massive corporations that were paying $0 in taxes, and to provide more funding to the IRS to strengthen enforcement against corporations and wealthy tax cheats. But look: billionaire donors and corporate interests are spending big this year to try to elect Trump and his GOP allies in November — and reap big rewards for themselves in the years to come with Republicans controlling the White House, U.S. Senate, and U.S. House. They’ve got money and power. But the number of people that make up our grassroots movement is powerful, too. We can beat them if we fight side by side, one grassroots donation at a time, to pass this legislation that will make our economy fairer for the middle class. [**I’m able to stay in these fights because supporters like you chip in whatever and whenever they can to strengthen our fight for these policies. And I’m fighting hard to make sure Republicans don’t flip this seat and the Senate. Can you help grow our grassroots campaign and support my re-election with a donation of $28 or any amount?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2772?amount=28&t=8&akid=2369%2E4032634%2EMdKyY5)

Can I explain something, folks?
I grew up in a twenty-four-by-thirty-six foot house. I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat grinding accident when I was a kid. I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents.
**In fact, I’m very proud to be the U.S. Senate’s only working dirt farmer.**
Every spring, I spend a lot of weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive.
I buy grease by the case and seeds by the ton. I butcher my own beef. My wife, Sharla, and I work the farm hand-in-hand.
The task of scheduling my work in the Senate around the inflexible timing of farm responsibilities drives my staff crazy—but they know my farm work is non-negotiable. It keeps me, quite literally, grounded.
**And rather than spend my days hobnobbing with special interests, I rely on hard-working folks like you to power everything we do.**

I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents. = Can I explain something, folks? I grew up in a twenty-four-by-thirty-six foot house. I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat grinding accident when I was a kid. I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents. In fact, I’m very proud to be the U.S. Senate’s only working dirt farmer. Every spring, I spend a lot of weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive. I buy grease by the case and seeds by the ton. I butcher my own beef. My wife, Sharla, and I work the farm hand-in-hand. The task of scheduling my work in the Senate around the inflexible timing of farm responsibilities drives my staff crazy—but they know my farm work is non-negotiable. It keeps me, quite literally, grounded. Friends --
We made a very difficult decision last week.
We had a Team Slotkin meeting where it became clear that if we had a bit more money, we could make a real play for additional votes as voting was underway across the state.
The money wasn’t in the budget. But I gave the green light.
It’s a risk. But this is the moment to take some risks. I’ve had similar moments in prior years. We can’t get caught short when people are already casting their ballots in this election. That'd be a mistake.
But the bet we made was that, as the race tightens, and if we asked, our supporters would come through to help fill the gap. We hope that you will. To keep the Senate in the hands of the Democrats.
So with that in mind: [**can you make a $3 contribution before our final FEC fundraising deadline ends in just a few days to help us fill the budget gap we created going after the voters we need to persuade to help win this race? $3 isn’t much, but at this point it’s the small-dollar donations that are making a difference here at the end.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241013-1-900&t=2&akid=2053%2E135344%2EgSvqy6)
Like I said, it was a tough call. But if there’s one thing that distinguishes this campaign from every other, it’s our people. You answer the call every single time. $3 is all we need to close the gap.

_By Beth Ann Rosica_
Despite receiving state tax dollars for services related to gender transition and sex reassignment, Children’s Hospital Of Pennsylvania (CHOP) refuses to share annual reports or answer questions while at the same time, tax dollars spent at this clinic and others in the state have rocketed upwards by an astonishing 8000 percent in just nine years.

The practice of providing gender transition services to children has erupted into a national controversy over the past few years, resulting in one of the most polarizing political issues. While many other countries have stopped the use of medical interventions for children with gender dysphoria, the state and federal governments specifically continue to support and encourage the treatments.

Since 2015, Pennsylvania has spent over $23 million of taxpayers dollars on sex reassignment and transition-related services and drugs for minors, according to a response to a Right to Know request filed with the Pennsylvania Department of Human Services by _Broad + Liberty_.

**Why It Matters**. CHOP’s unwillingness to discuss the number of patients it serves and the types of treatment they receive raises questions and ethical issues. The Gender and Sexuality Clinic allegedly produces an annual report but they refused to share it when requested.

CHOP’s clinic clearly has support from the governor’s office and the U.S. Department of Health. They appear to be working together to ensure gender transition and sex reassignment services are readily available for children and may be paid for, at least in part, with taxpayer dollars.

The clinic’s founders are uninterested in discussing science or even providing a rational explanation as to why they have not re-evaluated their practices. By continuing to ignore questions, their actions give reason for pause. As a leading provider of pediatric services, CHOP has an ethical responsibility to be transparent about its treatment methodologies, and they must be willing to defend them.

### **2.[Fighting antisemitism and supporting Israel in the year since October 7](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=a2783e4c64&e=b7b3eddce2)**

_By Jeff Bartos_
As we celebrate the Jewish New Year, commence the ten days of Teshuvah between Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur, and commemorate the first anniversary of October 7th, our family is reflecting on a year of action, advocacy, philanthropy, and resolute devotion to the relationship between the United States and our indispensable ally, Israel.

Early on the morning of October 7, 2023, my wife Sheryl and I woke to the terrible news in Israel and could not even begin to comprehend what was happening. After scouring American and Israeli news outlets, I spoke with our daughters and tried, unsuccessfully, to alleviate their anxiety and sorrow as they tried to make sense of the incomprehensible videos and news from Israel. Thereafter followed a series of calls with family and friends in the United States and WhatsApp messages with friends in Israel as we watched, in horror, as the scope of the atrocities came into focus.

**Why It Matters**. This summer, I traveled to Israel to hug friends, support local businesses, and bear witness. On June 24th, I visited the Gaza envelope, including the Nova Festival Victims Memorial, the burnt car wall, Kibbutz Alumim, and Netivot. I drove Route 232 and the intersections that were the site of many critical battles on October 7th, and I also drove the farm roads near the border that became infamous from the videos that the terrorists posted that day.

While visiting the sites was indeed solemn and chilling, I found my meetings with Israelis who had already moved back to the Gaza envelope to be unexpectedly inspiring. In particular, their courage, their resolve and their dedication to Zionism was deeply moving.

Everywhere I went, and every meal I shared with friends, included something extraordinary. At some point in every visit or meal, an Israeli friend (or two) would quiet the group and share their immense gratitude to me and my fellow Americans for visiting Israel at this time. Our Israeli friends often discussed how they felt abandoned by much of the world and expressed gratitude for our support and friendship.

# **4\. What we're reading**
Kamala Harris picked Tim Walz as her running mate to increase her support among rural voters. It isn’t working. That’s the take from [David Siders at POLITICO](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=bfd66dd961&e=b7b3eddce2) as he takes a swing through rural Minnesota to talk to voters who cast their ballots for Walz in the past, but won’t be doing it again.

“I call it the Democrat ‘smash and grab’ in the Capitol,” said Karla Salier, who was in the bleachers to watch her son, Jack, ride a horse in a Sunset Saddle Club event at the county fairgrounds. “They went for everything they could get to make us a sanctuary for transgenders and illegals. They just went nuts.”
When her husband, Bill, called Walz a “phony,” she said, “A flannel shirt doesn’t mean you blend in in the country.”

Dear Friend,

Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

The survey has only eight questions, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America.

**The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.**

Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents...

...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties.

At the same time, with the help of the media it...

* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
* Hides the corruption of the ruling class
* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.**

By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption.

Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=85d5bd7c5e4e44d18822d72af151e743&_e=h6X5FmyxhbVIoAFLO5Pvv--AVJRWYOmdQriMHk2xcy0HFIRHlSpQq9GKxXkn2_hD3G7nFlcDxwn-6k0Df4lqzIKxiq-ty03PNIGn4FyCHOs0XakXia1UI94JfudTA8cgrUXs7CG3xjIQ1evpFl2aj7798fk41cdFxrf3sB6rpSMcxvEQuuM-mWEb_Uhkb3pCTbEsbFGeANzGVtAp7GRWQW8n03zyYKmkGALh8BUNChOQHMOKN-9tfdR0YkeUXoblbeFaVgE0OBUNSkZKTHrEc-FlQve3CaZuODAuBpEK-IhQnkSr9z2KW8S0GxDgKl1l03zmKBU644-LMcFXodZpAksgwXZewHOtptq-zomTPrzpOvwoHfUl2GTZqPxLBBckIjhingRkFb4bGAbs89Iegg%3D%3D)**

The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.**

Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack.

**You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.**

A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.**

These efforts include:

* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It only has eight questions and will take a few minutes of your time.

Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

**This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=85d5bd7c5e4e44d18822d72af151e743&_e=h6X5FmyxhbVIoAFLO5Pvv--AVJRWYOmdQriMHk2xcy0HFIRHlSpQq9GKxXkn2_hD3G7nFlcDxwn-6k0Df4lqzIKxiq-ty03PNIGn4FyCHOs0XakXia1UI94JfudTA8cgrUXs7CG3xjIQ1evpFl2aj7798fk41cdFxrf3sB6rpSMcxvEQuuM-mWEb_Uhkb3pCTbEsbFGeANzGVtAp7GRWQW8n03zyYKmkGALh8BUNChMnDLTE7lz0EJYXUOJWBFU3XhW2hK-eMhiStVVzcDE4K0Kz5NiO1rvoVeFQyFlBOr4HxXW8jlaU2YCIBhcYpDFMv-4OoY7miNTjH6NYlQqDHhEn01-_y8VdtTZzizGLxZnzHgue6jUvqJBht5_b6xkaBLNbewuG4pQutUX-XAsr5A%3D%3D)**

Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Dhillon Producing and promoting free online courses for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics Providing a classical K-12 curriculum with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our National Survey on the Department of Justice and returning it to me as soon as possible. It only has eight questions and will take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to reach and teach millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty. If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached National Survey on the Department of Justice , which you can access at this secure link: ** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 -.

---
Climbing into the cockpit of my Apache helicopter and strapping myself in was the greatest adrenaline rush of my life. (The second was announcing I was running for Congress.) | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94922523/504999648/1012840921?refcode=em_fl_eha_20241013_fr_apachers_cand_mf_30da_xx_img&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzM5OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZGJiNDVlZC02ODg5LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MM_OJl9f_p-m2nOUQIHI9fPVMLCCg42L1FDNr1ncJbU=)
---
See, the Apache helicopters are basically airborne tanks. And our primary job as pilots was to provide cover for troops on the ground. So when I'd get the call to fly out, I'd race out to the Apache, put on my helmet, clip into my seat, and turn on the 48-foot rotor blades – all with the thought, **"I'm going to protect my people."**
And then off we'd fly.
That mentality, of being a protector, has never left me. And it's why I'm running for Congress – because I won't sit by when I see working families, veterans, women, LGBTQ+ folks, or anyone else who calls this country home being attacked.
**But this time, instead of jumping into an Apache helicopter to protect my people, I'm jumping into the race to represent Pennsylvania's First Congressional District.**
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94922526/504999650/1012840921?refcode=em_fl_eha_20241013_fr_apachers_cand_mf_30da_xx_img&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzM5OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZGJiNDVlZC02ODg5LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MM_OJl9f_p-m2nOUQIHI9fPVMLCCg42L1FDNr1ncJbU=)
---
Of course, just like how nothing in the Army gets done alone, neither does running for office. It takes a whole team of people – but instead of co-pilots and platoons it's a campaign manager, volunteers, and yes, donors.
**[That's why, as much as I hate asking for money, I'm asking you to pitch in $10 to this campaign. body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Since this time last year, Justice Democrats and our elected leaders in
Congress have led the call for an immediate, permanent ceasefire, the
return of Israeli and Palestinian hostages, and the de-escalation of
violence to prevent an all-out regional war in the Middle East.

Unfortunately, the majority of U.S. officials — who take thousands or even
millions of dollars in campaign contributions from anti-Palestinian lobby
group AIPAC — have not joined this call for peace. Meanwhile, the White
House has enabled far-right Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to
not only carry out genocide against Palestinians in Gaza and the West
Bank, but also to bomb and invade Lebanon.

In one year, the Israeli military has killed at least 41,000 Palestinians
— that’s 1 out of every 55 people in Gaza, with 69% of victims being women
and children. In Lebanon, the death toll rises daily, with more than 2,100
people killed so far in the past month. As long as our country continues
to send bombs and weapons to Israel, this violence will not end.

Currently, only seventeen leaders in Congress have demanded the U.S. halt
arms transfers to Israel, and ten out of the twelve House members are
Justice Democrats incumbents.

from around the world

embargo. Will you add your name to join them in demanding the U.S. stop

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition-20241013-arms-embargo/?source=em20241013-36064&akid=36064%2E1203867%2E4VZeMw ]Take Action

The sooner our leaders stop enabling Israel’s far-right government, the
more lives we can save and the sooner we can achieve peace.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Peter -
My name is Aquilino Gonell. I served this country for half of my life, first in the Army and then as a United States Capitol Police Sergeant.
And I had to fight for my life at the Capitol on January 6th while it was under attack from insurrectionists inspired by people like Kari Lake.
I am writing because inciting, cheering on, and making excuses for an attack on our democracy should not be a prerequisite or credential to be in Congress or any position of trusted authority.
But Kari Lake has used lies and conspiracies around January 6th to elevate her candidacy and build credibility with the far-right and Trump’s MAGA supporters.
That’s why I am personally writing to ask for your help, to send a message that we cannot allow insurrectionist-cheerleaders to get into the United States Senate.
Please:
[**Can you make a contribution to Ruben Gallego’s campaign for Senate in Arizona?**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct24.6QErJb&refcode=em241013-1-160&t=2&akid=3340%2E734936%2ET9H81k)

Kari Lake has insinuated that the insurrection at the Capitol was a “false flag” set up by the FBI.
I was there. You saw it happen. These were not FBI agents. They were Trump fanatics, and they were ready to storm the Capitol on his orders. More than 1100 of them have been charged with crimes like assault and seditious conspiracy.
I can assure you they were not spreading the word of God as they cursed at law enforcement officers and assaulted us with multiple weapons. I wonder how Christian and loving the invading rioters were as they threatened to shoot me, and said that I, an Army veteran and police officer, should be executed.
These attacks were inspired by lies told by far-right leaders like Kari Lake. Dozens of officers were seriously injured. People died.
I am going to do everything I can to help elect my friend Ruben Gallego, who also showed extraordinary courage that day. So, I am humbly asking:

Hello,
When my husband Adam Frisch ran against Lauren Boebert in 2022, we were the underdogs until the very end.
Adam did not receive any national support. We were heavily out-raised and out-spent by Boebert and her Washington allies.
Ultimately, though, Adam lost in a recount by just 546 votes – the closest race in the entire country.

Adam might not say it, but I will: If we had had additional resources and been able to fully fund his campaign until the end, Adam would probably be in Congress right now – and Lauren Boebert would be a footnote in a history book. It’s part of why Adam announced so early that he was running again. We needed to make sure that we have the money to build a campaign that can sustain all the way through to November 5, 2024. But with Lauren Boebert having run off scared, this race is now a lot harder. The Super PACs are attacking Adam, and he’s not taking any money from corporate PACs. If he is going to win this critical House seat, Adam needs grassroots donors like you to chip in right now: = Please use the links in this email to start a weekly donation through ActBlue: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = From our entire family, thank you. body:
It’s about saving our democracy.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94928244/505014109/-849459103?refcode=ea.e3b09687-6d89-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ms=ea.e3b09687-6d89-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlM2IwOTY4Ny02ZDg5LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wBDlFQMqZVMrk2pkHuQMT7s-tGsDCONB27K6VVz5OIM=&emci=4967ff39-e287-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=e3b09687-6d89-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=46764483)

Let me be clear: this election isn’t only about Democrats vs. Republicans. It’s about defeating wannabe fascists like Marsha Blackburn and saving our democracy. Marsha has no issue aligning herself with people like Donald Trump — the same guy who threatened to lock up his political opponents. He attacks the free press and vows to be a “dictator for a day.” She’s also aggressively pushed for a nationwide abortion ban. She’s spread Big Lie conspiracy theories that undermine our democracy and refuses to distance herself from Project 2025 — a far-right plan designed to dismantle voting rights, roll back LGBTQ protections, and hand out tax breaks to the ultra-wealthy while working families pay the price. I believe in the power of the people. I believe in honesty, integrity, and fighting for what’s right. ### October 26th \- Get Out the Vote Fundraiser!
Join Tristan, Senate Minority Leader Nickie Antonio, Mayor Meghan George, Representative Michael Skindell, and many other friends and supporters at Sauced in Lakewood on Saturday, October 26th, for a fundraiser and GET OUT THE VOTE event for Tristan Rader for State Representative.
**Saturday, October 26th
2PM - 4PM
Sauced Taproom**
_14701 Detroit Ave.
Lakewood, Ohio_

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

I don’t think we need that – because we have grassroots supporters like you who can help us win. But if we fall short of this goal, it’s going to be hard for us to catch up given how little time is left before Election Day.

You may know me as an actor, but what I'm reaching out to you about today is much more important than my latest movie: It's about Jacky Rosen's battleground Senate race in Nevada.

I want to explain to you why I'm behind Jacky – but if you're short on time, [**please join me and split $5 between her campaign and the DSCC now to keep Nevada and the Senate blue!**](https://go.dscc.org/go/12711?amount=5&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FM-20241013-JosephGordonLevitt-NevadaTandem-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FM-20241013-JosephGordonLevitt-NevadaTandem-Pros-sl1&akid=18203%2E9716520%2E0EbblS)

But right now, **_Jacky is also fighting to defend Nevada in the toughest and most high-stakes election of her life._**

That's because Nevada is crucial to securing the White House and Senate this cycle, but** _The Cook Political Report_ is calling it the "most perilous" battleground for Democrats. **

ALL of us should be worried about what will happen if the election doesn't go our way this year. I know I am.

Trump is threatening to act like a dictator if elected to the White House. Amid allegations of corruption within its conservative majority, the Supreme Court is making _unthinkable_ decisions on presidential immunity that will effectively put Trump above the law if reelected.

name: Andrew Yang
subject: The Path Forward
body:
We are doing the thing that others believe to be out-of-reach. At some point in the future, people will look up and say, “Wow, they did what?” | |
---
| | |
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=b2b35be188&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=f1d9535398&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
| Hello. I’m heading to Nebraska on Tuesday to campaign for [Dan Osborn](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=716e12e91c&e=0f227c2ae3), who is running for Senate in Nebraska and is leading the incumbent in recent polls. Dan is running as an Independent and represents one of the great opportunities in November. Forward has endorsed dozens of local [candidates](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=2034b90e40&e=0f227c2ae3) – we are running a fundraising campaign with a goal of $25,000 – if you are able to do so please [donate](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=c4f47520b6&e=0f227c2ae3) $25 or whatever you can to Forward today. It will help us do a lot of good. Thousands of people donate to Forward every year, which I’m immensely grateful for. Imagine everyday Americans donating hundreds of thousands of dollars to improve democracy and present real choice. We are doing the thing that others believe to be out-of-reach. At some point in the future, people will look up and say, “Wow, they did what?” [Dan Osborn](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=2e748220f7&e=0f227c2ae3) is a huge overlooked opportunity, but there are others including [Adam Frisch](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=fbae952d9d&e=0f227c2ae3), [John Avlon](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=064d353fec&e=0f227c2ae3), [Eric Settle](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=8a84d678b0&e=0f227c2ae3) and the other candidates that Forward has endorsed. One candidate – [John Curtis](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=75ca54f081&e=0f227c2ae3) – is certain to be the next U.S. Senator representing Utah in Mitt Romney’s old seat. The two parties are spending billions beating each other up – I get multiple texts every day – while we are earnestly building the alternative on a shoestring. Still, we are not unmindful of the general election and all that is at stake. Our activities in Pennsylvania, Nevada, North Carolina and other contested states could be the difference-maker speaking to different audiences. As I put in a recent post: “I get the frustration. I just don’t think Donald Trump is the answer.” There are also half-a-dozen states that are considering primary reform a la Alaska- the subject of my [TED talk](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=b12bcd94f4&e=0f227c2ae3) that is now over 2.1 million views - including Nevada, Colorado, Arizona, Montana, Idaho and South Dakota as well as Oregon considering Ranked Choice Voting. These might not get the headlines on Election Night but they are very high-stakes.
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=5f8640ef40&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
| People ask what [Forward](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=8f57e74db2&e=0f227c2ae3) is about all the time. Forward is a positive independent movement to reform our politics by boosting reforms, supporting good [candidates](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=55974cc0bf&e=0f227c2ae3) of any party, and creating a third party that can reduce the polarization, hostility and dysfunction that make our politics unresponsive to the problems of this age. We have dozens of affiliated elected officials and our co-chairs include the two-term [Governor of New Jersey](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=d37ef74051&e=0f227c2ae3), the former [Lt. Governor of Massachusetts](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=e9e7a8e4b1&e=0f227c2ae3) and a certain [entrepreneur](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=3c9a5dd66d&e=0f227c2ae3) who wants good things for people. We’ve accomplished a lot over the last few years but we have a long way to go. Thank you. Let’s work for the best in November. To donate to Forward’s campaign click [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=b03ace083a&e=0f227c2ae3). You can also buy swag [here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=e2c10e2d67&e=0f227c2ae3). And thank you again for your belief and support.
---
| **
Andrew Yang**
Co-Chair, Forward Party
[forwardparty.com](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=1b4a581854&e=0f227c2ae3)
[andrewyang.com](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=779414598f&e=0f227c2ae3)

Donald Trump’s disrespect of Americans with disabilities has no limit.
He told wealthy donors that Kamala Harris was “retarded,” told his own family members that a relative with a disability “should just die,” and viciously mocked a reporter’s disability to a jeering crowd of thousands.
[](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqtHtWNDtXR0WReOmqZcCOXO2FiuxEhBk3zsUTCYW6F8lJ9B6_AihAH_9ZI9lErQFb78dVVZjSt5vhJBH1UGTObrv2TgjEVx5UwR5btnGThtJ7p8PhQvwsLciZTz4oL4iQThkQyGYEmHHXtkirp2SqX_ot5Fwj4_B6iq_Eg1Iu9XAGozt8wy84-LFgwBliBWt_umif1mRS8uJiGKpWS3gVbgX_k7CN-gWNiacYCRmuvtUOXhitiOlG-rpLB8jG0h8xYwNO2SJvBpACXwxUCYJQB5sv_afJL-tCcySjJfCswEMreKaRXfGPg6q3v81VpNCdM0YPTbJe7tVE-yOqIkhOuL00lM0kEoXRwYdrat4RQgFwy9_qSqGo_9fGyLK0PPDEM/4ak/gES0c9q5RKurhSMHFI3ccg/h2/h001.IXVDeYIFiqmCTGoOyTIKToSMn3P6mjgOYTjm3_rgb-8)
As founder of Able Dems, this fight is personal.

Growing up as a wheelchair user with a stutter, I was called “retarded.” People underestimated me - like they do with many Americans with disabilities.
But I never gave up - and today, I’m asking you to fight alongside me to defeat MAGA Republicans.
We won’t let them throw us off of healthcare, gut Social Security and Medicare, or attack democracy.
We won’t let them elect a convicted felon who mocks and disrespects disabilities as President.

clean_body: | | | Donald Trump said a disabled relative “should just die,” wants to kick disabled Americans off of health care, mocks disabilities on stage, and now uses vile slurs to disrespect Kamala Harris. Donald Trump’s disrespect of Americans with disabilities has no limit. He told wealthy donors that Kamala Harris was “retarded,” told his own family members that a relative with a disability “should just die,” and viciously mocked a reporter’s disability to a jeering crowd of thousands. As founder of Able Dems, this fight is personal. Growing up as a wheelchair user with a stutter, I was called “retarded.” People underestimated me - like they do with many Americans with disabilities. But I never gave up - and today, I’m asking you to fight alongside me to defeat MAGA Republicans. We won’t let them throw us off of healthcare, gut Social Security and Medicare, or attack democracy. subject: Can we count on your support?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsodHzaWN4
Do you look forward to reading speeches from America's smartest
and most interesting conservatives each month?
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osodHzaWN4

Please see a special message from our sponsor:

Dear
Fellow American,

Are you
enjoying your Imprimis subscription?

Do you
look forward to reading speeches from America's smartest and most
interesting conservatives each month?

I hope
so.

You will
never have to pay for Imprimis because we want its message in
defense of liberty and the American way of life to reach as many
citizens as possible.

We're
grateful that you read Imprimis, and we hope you share your copy
with others after you've read it-and that you encourage others
you know to sign up for their own free subscriptions.

Hillsdale
relies on a nationwide network of supporters-people like you-to
help in our efforts to promote the ideas of limited government,
free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and
strong national defense.

You're a
longtime Imprimis subscriber, so you're certainly aware of how
the far-Left attacks the moral and political foundations of our
country.

And you
understand that to defeat the powerful forces that seek to
undermine our freedom, we need to ramp up our efforts to educate
the American people about our founding principles of
liberty…the importance of reviving limited constitutional
government…the need to defend the rule of law…and
the fact that prosperity is dependent on a system of free
enterprise.

That's
why I want to know if you can offer your support to Hillsdale
College.

Other
colleges and universities have fallen prey to moral and cultural
relativism and the oppression of "political
correctness"-Hillsdale has not-and it continues to fulfill its
mission of defending civil and religious liberty through
education.

Will you
help?

In
addition to sending Imprimis to more Americans, you will help
us…

Teach
Americans of all ages who wish to learn about the Declaration of
Independence, the Constitution, free-market economics, American
Heritage, the Great Books, and more through free online courses
(to date, more than 4 million students have registered for one or
more courses);

Launch and support dozens more classical K-12 schools
nationwide-schools where students receive an education rooted in
the liberal arts and sciences and learn the importance of moral
character and civic virtue. More than 15,000 students currently
attend over 90 Hillsdale-affiliated K-12 schools, and thousands
more are on waiting lists.

Your
support is especially needed today because Hillsdale College does
not accept one penny in taxpayer support-not even indirectly in
the form of federal or state student grants and loans. We refuse
to allow the government to interfere with our internal affairs.

So, we
rely on the support of informed patriots like you, who understand
the importance of education to liberty.

Whatever
amount you give today, whether it's…

>> $25
>> $35
>> $50
>> $100
>> $250

…will help us defend the freedom of the American people
and the American way of life through education.

Simply
click the link below and let us know if we can count on your
support.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63622643:sodHzaWN4:m:3:2627245898:E7FB227C5175C1218C1BD07ABADB1FCD:r

Thank you
in advance for your help in reaching and teaching millions more
Americans on behalf of liberty.

Warm
regards,

Larry P.
Arnn

President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing
Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

He couldn't have been more than 17 or 18. A kid by any measure. His eyes lit up when he saw me.
"Brother, are you Muslim?" he asked.
"Yes. Asalaamo Alaikum brother," I replied.
"Wa alaikum asalaam! What is your name, brother?"
"Qasim."
"Are you here from America brother Qasim?"
"Yes."
"Come. Let me show you Hebron. Let me show you my city, and our famous mosque."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/944dbb51-34d6-47d2-b9c0-fe4aea91cba9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
A photo of the only Palestinian flag I found during my time in Occupied Palestine, tucked away from public view. The Israeli government has made it illegal for Palestinians to fly their own flag in their own nation.
I smiled at him and nodded as we began walking together. The famous mosque he referred to was the Ibrahimi Mosque. A sacred and ancient mosque that is said to be the [final resting place](https://substack.com/redirect/c1efc93b-07cb-44c9-931f-e56fe29ba8b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for prophet Abraham, his wife Sarah, their son Isaac and grandson Jacob, and their wives Rebecca and Leah.
An ancient mosque revered by Muslims, Christians, and Jews alike, tragedy struck when a terrorist attacked the Ibrahimi Mosque in the horrifying 1994 Cave of the Patriarchs massacre. A massacre executed by American-Israeli physician, Dr. Baruch Goldstein, who dressed up in an Israeli military uniform and opened fire on Palestinian Muslims as they worshipped, killing dozens and injuring hundreds. Goldstein committed his terrorist attack during the holy month of Ramadan. Below is a 30 second clip of the detailed tour my Palestinian host graciously afforded me in Hebron. I deliberately do not depict him or name him for his own safety.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/07821368-c361-4b49-a5c8-9ca5d851799d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..WqrwZxl89gUH8EN9_wcr8xZ-XEcCzzSFDBiXyrbE2Bw?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=150147360)
## A planned attack
Baruch Goldstein's terrorist attack was not unexpected. He was a member of a known US State Department designated zionist terrorist organization called the Kach Movement. In 1981 the New York Times published a letter to the editor from Goldstein, where he wrote Israel "_must act decisively to remove the Arab minority from within its borders_." And even as he worked as a physician in Israel, Goldstein reportedly refused to treat Arabs, even Arabs in the Israeli military.
Then, in 1993 Goldstein "acted decisively" and committed an acid attack on Palestinians at the Ibrahimi mosque, assaulting six worshippers. And despite warnings to the Israeli government from Israel's own intelligence agency Shin Bet, that Goldstein was an existential threat to Palestinians, the Israeli government took no meaningful action to hold him accountable. Thus, Goldstein's 1994 attack was his second attack, and the result of abject disregard for the safety of Palestinians living on their own land. On that fateful day on February 25, 1994, Goldstein murdered 29 Palestinian Muslims as they worshipped, and injured 125 more. He was finally subdued and beaten to death.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bededf8b-921e-425a-8d78-4ac986d9230d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Inside the main hall of the Ibrahimi mosque, where known zionist terrorist Baruch Goldstein massacred 29 innocent Palestinians as they worshipped. [Credit: Personal photo]
One would think that Goldstein is today derided as the racist, terrorist, and mass murderer he was. And certainly many accurately deride him as that. Still, I was disturbed to find in Hebron an alter built in honor of Goldstein. And lest anyone claim this is a one off, the alter is built opposite Meir Kahane Memorial Park in Kiryat Arba, an illegal Israeli settlement next to Hebron. An entire memorial built to Rabbi Meir Kahane, the founder of the Israeli far-right political party Kach, which is the aforementioned US State Department designated zionist terrorist organization of which Goldstein was a devout member. And as we watched and observed Goldstein's tomb, we witnessed illegal Israeli settlers arrive to pay their respects and prayers for him, praising him as a hero of Israel. Indeed, inscribed on Goldstein's tomb in Hebrew is, "_He gave his life for the people of Israel, its Torah and land_."
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..WqrwZxl89gUH8EN9_wcr8xZ-XEcCzzSFDBiXyrbE2Bw?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=150147360)
## Apartheid in Hebron
As I exited the Ibrahimi mosque my host greeted me with a smile and continued the tour of his home city. The city where he was born, raised, and had never left. We walked a few hundred meters down the street, past where we initially met. Momentarily distracted I looked down at my phone to respond to a text and kept walking. As I looked up I noticed my host had vanished. I suddenly walked alone. Bewildered I turned around and saw him standing about 25 meters behind me.
I waved my arm and motioned for him to come and continue our conversation.
"Come back brother. I cannot walk to you!" He yelled out to me.
Confused I walked back towards him, "What do you mean you cannot walk to me? Come, I'm enjoying our conversation. Let us continue."
I arrived back to the imaginary line he seemed unable to cross. Like a mime stuck in a box, he could not move forward. As we spoke an Israeli family walked past us, impervious to the imaginary line blocking my Palestinian host.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ae350683-f52d-448d-8dce-7a4d6c2b0e58?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
"You don't understand brother Qasim. I cannot cross. They will arrest me."
"Who??"
"Them."
He pointed the Israeli soldiers dressed in full uniform, armed to the teeth with assault rifles.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/56fef23e-1921-4a25-b9e8-05c26dcd50f0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
"Don't worry, brother. Come with me."
In my ignorance, and foolishness, I believed I had some ability to protect my host from the Israeli military illegally occupying Hebron. Or perhaps I found it so incredulous that a Palestinian born and raised in Hebron could not walk in his own city without being arrested, simply for the crime of walking while Palestinian, that I forced myself to believe there must be some other explanation?
"No brother Qasim. You don't understand. I cannot go any further than this location."
"But that Israeli family just walked past us no problem?"
"The Israelis can walk there, but we cannot."
"You cannot walk on your own streets?" I vocalized my disbelief to my host.
"No, only the Israelis can walk on these roads. We are not allowed to walk here."
"Why not? When did this start?"
"After the terrorist attack in the Ibrahimi mosque. The Israeli government shut everything down. Our businesses. Our streets. Our entire city."
"Wait, I'm confused. That terrorist attack was by an Israeli, Baruch Goldstein. Why are Palestinians being punished on their own land for suffering the violence of a foreign terrorist?"
He took a deep breath and sighed. A glimpse of sadness. A pause, as if to look around to ensure no one else was listening. Or perhaps from the exhaustion of having to repeatedly explain this basic fact of his life to every new visitor to Hebron.
"This is, how you say, this is the apartheid we are living in. I'm sorry brother Qasim. I wish I could show you the rest of my beloved city. I just cannot go any further from here."
I felt selfish and embarrassed at my own ignorance. Angry and confused for my host. I felt my eyes well up with tears of rage but I knew I had to keep my composure. Like a gut punch I realized that it was not simply that my host had never tried to leave Hebron--it is that he _could not_ leave Hebron. He was a prisoner in his own home. I was neither Israeli nor Palestinian. Yet I could walk freely and with more security in a city I'd never been to, than my Palestinian host could, though he was born and raised in the city of Hebron. A city that had roads and streets reserved only for illegal Israeli settlers and non-Palestinian foreigners like myself. A city with streets for one racial class, but not for another.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..WqrwZxl89gUH8EN9_wcr8xZ-XEcCzzSFDBiXyrbE2Bw?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=150147360)
## Reflections
I had felt this suffocation before. Back when I was about this young man's age in 2000, visiting Robben Island in South Africa. I heard directly from former political prisoners who suffered alongside Nelson Mandela about the apartheid conditions under which they existed. And as I heard my Palestinian host describe his life in Hebron, my mind conjured up those reflections of apartheid South Africa and indeed of Jim Crow America. Suddenly, my host made a comment laced with urgency that made me snap out of my self-pity.
"Brother Qasim I have to go. I cannot stay here. They're coming!"
"Who's coming?"
I turned around to see Israeli soldiers pointing at us and walking towards us. I looked back and my host walked as quickly as he could with his head down, trying not to draw any additional attention to himself. He'd been afflicted by a fear I did not realize at the moment, but would soon. I thought about calling out after him, but I didn't know what I would say. I turned back around to see myself surrounded by Israeli soldiers, rifles in hand, demanding I show them my papers--or else.
And that's when they found out I was born in Pakistan, a country that does not recognize the State of Israel. They were not pleased.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b325f9fa-3e9a-4bb0-a440-c65c57b6ca3f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Armed Israeli soldier in Occupied Palestine brandishing his firearm demands my 'papers' under threat of arrest.
