When possible, I hope you'll consider upgrading to a $6/mo or $50/year subscription! Apartheid in Hebron | | | Oct 13 | | | | | | | | | | | | He couldn't have been more than 17 or 18. A kid by any measure. His eyes lit up when he saw me. "Brother, are you Muslim?" he asked. "Yes. Asalaamo Alaikum brother," I replied. "Wa alaikum asalaam! What is your name, brother?" "Qasim." "Are you here from America brother Qasim?" "Yes." "Come. Let me show you Hebron. Let me show you my city, and our famous mosque." | | ---|---|--- A photo of the only Palestinian flag I found during my time in Occupied Palestine, tucked away from public view. The Israeli government has made it illegal for Palestinians to fly their own flag in their own nation. I smiled at him and nodded as we began walking together. The famous mosque he referred to was the Ibrahimi Mosque. A sacred and ancient mosque that is said to be the for prophet Abraham, his wife Sarah, their son Isaac and grandson Jacob, and their wives Rebecca and Leah. An ancient mosque revered by Muslims, Christians, and Jews alike, tragedy struck when a terrorist attacked the Ibrahimi Mosque in the horrifying 1994 Cave of the Patriarchs massacre. A massacre executed by American-Israeli physician, Dr. Baruch Goldstein, who dressed up in an Israeli military uniform and opened fire on Palestinian Muslims as they worshipped, killing dozens and injuring hundreds. Goldstein committed his terrorist attack during the holy month of Ramadan. Below is a 30 second clip of the detailed tour my Palestinian host graciously afforded me in Hebron. I deliberately do not depict him or name him for his own safety. A planned attack Baruch Goldstein's terrorist attack was not unexpected. He was a member of a known US State Department designated zionist terrorist organization called the Kach Movement. In 1981 the New York Times published a letter to the editor from Goldstein, where he wrote Israel "must act decisively to remove the Arab minority from within its borders." And even as he worked as a physician in Israel, Goldstein reportedly refused to treat Arabs, even Arabs in the Israeli military. Then, in 1993 Goldstein "acted decisively" and committed an acid attack on Palestinians at the Ibrahimi mosque, assaulting six worshippers. And despite warnings to the Israeli government from Israel's own intelligence agency Shin Bet, that Goldstein was an existential threat to Palestinians, the Israeli government took no meaningful action to hold him accountable. Thus, Goldstein's 1994 attack was his second attack, and the result of abject disregard for the safety of Palestinians living on their own land. On that fateful day on February 25, 1994, Goldstein murdered 29 Palestinian Muslims as they worshipped, and injured 125 more. He was finally subdued and beaten to death. | | ---|---|--- Inside the main hall of the Ibrahimi mosque, where known zionist terrorist Baruch Goldstein massacred 29 innocent Palestinians as they worshipped. [Credit: Personal photo] One would think that Goldstein is today derided as the racist, terrorist, and mass murderer he was. And certainly many accurately deride him as that. Still, I was disturbed to find in Hebron an alter built in honor of Goldstein. And lest anyone claim this is a one off, the alter is built opposite Meir Kahane Memorial Park in Kiryat Arba, an illegal Israeli settlement next to Hebron. An entire memorial built to Rabbi Meir Kahane, the founder of the Israeli far-right political party Kach, which is the aforementioned US State Department designated zionist terrorist organization of which Goldstein was a devout member. And as we watched and observed Goldstein's tomb, we witnessed illegal Israeli settlers arrive to pay their respects and prayers for him, praising him as a hero of Israel. Indeed, inscribed on Goldstein's tomb in Hebrew is, "He gave his life for the people of Israel, its Torah and land." Apartheid in Hebron As I exited the Ibrahimi mosque my host greeted me with a smile and continued the tour of his home city. The city where he was born, raised, and had never left. We walked a few hundred meters down the street, past where we initially met. Momentarily distracted I looked down at my phone to respond to a text and kept walking. As I looked up I noticed my host had vanished. I suddenly walked alone. Bewildered I turned around and saw him standing about 25 meters behind me. I waved my arm and motioned for him to come and continue our conversation. "Come back brother. I cannot walk to you!" He yelled out to me. Confused I walked back towards him, "What do you mean you cannot walk to me? Come, I'm enjoying our conversation. Let us continue." I arrived back to the imaginary line he seemed unable to cross. Like a mime stuck in a box, he could not move forward. As we spoke an Israeli family walked past us, impervious to the imaginary line blocking my Palestinian host. | | ---|---|--- "You don't understand brother Qasim. I cannot cross. They will arrest me." "Who??" "Them." He pointed the Israeli soldiers dressed in full uniform, armed to the teeth with assault rifles. | | ---|---|--- "Don't worry, brother. Come with me." In my ignorance, and foolishness, I believed I had some ability to protect my host from the Israeli military illegally occupying Hebron. Or perhaps I found it so incredulous that a Palestinian born and raised in Hebron could not walk in his own city without being arrested, simply for the crime of walking while Palestinian, that I forced myself to believe there must be some other explanation? "No brother Qasim. You don't understand. I cannot go any further than this location." "But that Israeli family just walked past us no problem?" "The Israelis can walk there, but we cannot." "You cannot walk on your own streets?" I vocalized my disbelief to my host. "No, only the Israelis can walk on these roads. We are not allowed to walk here." "Why not? When did this start?" "After the terrorist attack in the Ibrahimi mosque. The Israeli government shut everything down. Our businesses. Our streets. Our entire city." "Wait, I'm confused. That terrorist attack was by an Israeli, Baruch Goldstein. Why are Palestinians being punished on their own land for suffering the violence of a foreign terrorist?" He took a deep breath and sighed. A glimpse of sadness. A pause, as if to look around to ensure no one else was listening. Or perhaps from the exhaustion of having to repeatedly explain this basic fact of his life to every new visitor to Hebron. "This is, how you say, this is the apartheid we are living in. I'm sorry brother Qasim. I wish I could show you the rest of my beloved city. I just cannot go any further from here." I felt selfish and embarrassed at my own ignorance. Angry and confused for my host. I felt my eyes well up with tears of rage but I knew I had to keep my composure. Like a gut punch I realized that it was not simply that my host had never tried to leave Hebron--it is that he could not leave Hebron. He was a prisoner in his own home. I was neither Israeli nor Palestinian. Yet I could walk freely and with more security in a city I'd never been to, than my Palestinian host could, though he was born and raised in the city of Hebron. A city that had roads and streets reserved only for illegal Israeli settlers and non-Palestinian foreigners like myself. A city with streets for one racial class, but not for another. Reflections I had felt this suffocation before. Back when I was about this young man's age in 2000, visiting Robben Island in South Africa. I heard directly from former political prisoners who suffered alongside Nelson Mandela about the apartheid conditions under which they existed. And as I heard my Palestinian host describe his life in Hebron, my mind conjured up those reflections of apartheid South Africa and indeed of Jim Crow America. Suddenly, my host made a comment laced with urgency that made me snap out of my self-pity. "Brother Qasim I have to go. I cannot stay here. They're coming!" "Who's coming?" I turned around to see Israeli soldiers pointing at us and walking towards us. I looked back and my host walked as quickly as he could with his head down, trying not to draw any additional attention to himself. He'd been afflicted by a fear I did not realize at the moment, but would soon. I thought about calling out after him, but I didn't know what I would say. I turned back around to see myself surrounded by Israeli soldiers, rifles in hand, demanding I show them my papers--or else. And that's when they found out I was born in Pakistan, a country that does not recognize the State of Israel. They were not pleased. | | ---|---|--- Armed Israeli soldier in Occupied Palestine brandishing his firearm demands my 'papers' under threat of arrest. To be continued in Part 3. In 2012, I became the first gay person of color elected to Congress.

| Peter, in 2012, I became the first gay person of color elected to Congress.

So I was so proud to join my hometown, Riverside, California, for an incredible Riverside Pride celebration! [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94941115/505052269/238616526?amount=7&refcode=MTFC_20241013_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM2MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NTk3ZTNmZC03ZTg5LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Pa2V_GquyaisoU9R_Otj9l8j80Q4XhVwZkMrut7PAKA=) It’s been my absolute honor to serve and represent marginalized communities in Congress. I’ve advocated for LGBTQ+ folks, stood up to transphobic hate, and sponsored the Equality Act.

It wasn’t always easy. In a 1994 bid for Congress, _I was outed by my hateful Republican opponent._ And even today, we see the Republican Party seek to further marginalize and strip folks like me of our rights to exist, live, and love.

That’s why LGBTQ+ Pride is SO important. It’s a form of resistance against those hurtful and harmful narratives. It’s a celebration of who we are. _**And it’s just a good, fun time.**_

The Pride event I attended was a reminder to me of all that is at stake this election. It’s the difference between protecting LGBTQ+ rights or seeing them dismantled entirely.

**I don’t know about you, but like Kamala Harris says: I’m not going back.**

[**Can I count on you to chip in $7 to fund my work and ensure I can keep fighting for LGBTQ people and other marginalized communities for years to come? Fellow Conservative,

The minute _The Cook Political Report_ declared our race for Wisconsin’s MUST-WIN Senate seat a TOSS-UP, my campaign team knew we had to set an ambitious 48-hour fundraising target to maintain our campaign’s momentum and overcome the millions Tammy Baldwin & Chuck Schumer are going to throw at us.

I have some bad news that has me really worried... **We came up just a $1,000 short of our 48-hour fundraising objective.**

**48-HOUR FUNDRAISING TARGET
_> > $1,000 SHORT <<_**
🟩 🟩 🟩 🟩 🟩 🟩 🟩 🟩 ⬜

Peter,
**The climate crisis is here, and it’s affecting every corner of our nation.** Recent heat waves in the northwest and Hurricanes Helene and Milton in the southeast have reinforced that no part of America is safe from the impacts of climate change.
From coast to coast, our nation faces unprecedented threats from extreme weather, rising temperatures and environmental disasters. **All of us are at risk,** and every day of inaction puts more lives in danger.
When Democrats controlled Congress in 2021 and 2022, we made historic and unprecedented investments in clean energy and climate resilience that will pay off for years to come. **But there’s so much more we still need to do.**
[**If you want to make sure our leaders continue to prioritize the planet, will you add your name to our petition demanding stronger climate action today?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/climate-action-em20241013?source=em20241013&akid=4396%2E420207%2EzMH7Ro)

But there’s so much more we still need to do. We need to make our voices heard and demand a safer country for ourselves and our communities. Adding your name sends a powerful message: Americans won't stand by while MAGA leaders ignore the greatest threat to our future. Thank you for your commitment to this fight. name: Jane Fonda
subject: Art and activism go hand in hand.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee
body:
Both are near and dear to my heart.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94942984/505058182/1328794144?refcode=ea.c8b6519b-8389-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ms=ea.c8b6519b-8389-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImM4YjY1MTliLTgzODktZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=neBW628vm1IZHyx18OS1cEtGu3Ulb2TfkozqL3UrelE=&emci=9df667a9-0a88-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=c8b6519b-8389-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=4823105)
---
I’ve been an actor for over six decades now, but being an _activist_ is what keeps me alive. To me, the two aren’t so different. Art has always been a way to tell stories that matter, to foster empathy, and to connect people to a cause greater than themselves. **Art allowed me to see the world through my characters; activism gave me the voice to put empathy and care into action for people who need it most.** For decades, I’ve been on the front lines of major movements, from the fight for women’s rights to climate justice — and I’ve seen firsthand the change we can create in the world when we come together for a common goal. That’s why I launched the Jane Fonda Climate PAC — because I know that if we harness our collective power and direct it toward electing climate champions, we can create a livable future. We’re now 23 days away from a pivotal election where our future is on the line. It’s going to take all of us showing up, speaking out, and pitching in. Whether that means volunteering your time or **[chipping in a few dollars here or there,](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94942985/505058183/2105508926?refcode=ea.c8b6519b-8389-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ms=ea.c8b6519b-8389-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImM4YjY1MTliLTgzODktZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=neBW628vm1IZHyx18OS1cEtGu3Ulb2TfkozqL3UrelE=)** every bit of support helps us push through the final stretch. | [**DONATE**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94942986/505058184/2105508926?refcode=ea.c8b6519b-8389-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ms=ea.c8b6519b-8389-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImM4YjY1MTliLTgzODktZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=neBW628vm1IZHyx18OS1cEtGu3Ulb2TfkozqL3UrelE=)
---
I’ve been inspired by the many artists who are using their platforms for something bigger than themselves.
But _no_ amount of celebrity status will change anything if people don’t ACT. We all have a role in this movement. I often say that celebrities are like repeaters — like those antennas you see on mountain tops. We pick up the signals from people in the valleys — communities suffering from pollution, climate injustice, and environmental devastation — and we amplify them, making sure their stories reach more people.
I’ll do everything I can to be the best repeater I can, but I need you with me.

clean_body: Both are near and dear to my heart. | I’ve been an actor for over six decades now, but being an activist is what keeps me alive. To me, the two aren’t so different. Art has always been a way to tell stories that matter, to foster empathy, and to connect people to a cause greater than themselves. Art allowed me to see the world through my characters; activism gave me the voice to put empathy and care into action for people who need it most. For decades, I’ve been on the front lines of major movements, from the fight for women’s rights to climate justice — and I’ve seen firsthand the change we can create in the world when we come together for a common goal. That’s why I launched the Jane Fonda Climate PAC — because I know that if we harness our collective power and direct it toward electing climate champions, we can create a livable future. We’re now 23 days away from a pivotal election where our future is on the line. It’s going to take all of us showing up, speaking out, and pitching in. Whether that means volunteering your time or = every bit of support helps us push through the final stretch. | = I’ve been inspired by the many artists who are using their platforms for something bigger than themselves. But no amount of celebrity status will change anything if people don’t ACT. We all have a role in this movement. I often say that celebrities are like repeaters — like those antennas you see on mountain tops. We pick up the signals from people in the valleys — communities suffering from pollution, climate injustice, and environmental devastation — and we amplify them, making sure their stories reach more people. I’ll do everything I can to be the best repeater I can, but I need you with me. = = Onward, Jane Fonda = | = | = = Follow along: | | ---|---|--- Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. The Epoch Times is booming during a consequential election year

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94943715/505061178/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWZjMGQ0YzEtODQ4OS1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=bL3r3MYEFw_fb12fcccBEJenj2tr4foMFqRi2nAYhk0=&emci=c574d1ba-8489-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=9fc0d4c1-8489-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=14016711)
Remember _The Epoch Times_ , Peter?
_The Epoch Times_ is a far-right news outlet known for spreading anti-vaccine misinformation and 2020 election conspiracies. They spent more money on advertising for Donald Trump in 2020 than any organization outside the Trump campaign.
You may have seen their bizarre “#1 trusted news” billboards popping up in cities nationwide:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94943717/505061182/-260044646?refcode=20241013-EM-EpochTimes&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWZjMGQ0YzEtODQ4OS1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=bL3r3MYEFw_fb12fcccBEJenj2tr4foMFqRi2nAYhk0=)
Now, Peter, _The Epoch Times_ ’ influence is growing. Earlier this year, they announced the opening of a new journalism school to train the next generation of right-wing media stars. This summer, they expanded into the faith-based movie market, releasing a movie starring Cuba Gooding, Jr.
[**We’ll tell you more about their big year (and why it matters) in a moment. But if you want to help us combat _The Epoch Times_ ' right-wing propaganda and conspiracy theories, can you pitch in $17 now?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94943719/505061184/-260044646?refcode=20241013-EM-EpochTimes&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWZjMGQ0YzEtODQ4OS1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=bL3r3MYEFw_fb12fcccBEJenj2tr4foMFqRi2nAYhk0=)
This year hasn't been all good for _The Epoch Times_. In June, the Department of Justice indicted the Chief Financial Officer at _The Epoch Times_ in a multinational $67 million money laundering scheme. The scheme boosted revenues at _The Epoch Times_ by about 410%, and some of those dollars went directly to efforts to re-elect Trump in 2020.
While the DOJ has been working on the case, _The Epoch Times_ has been up and running, and most importantly, _growing_ rapidly.
In April, _The Epoch Times_ announced its goal to support a new journalism school in the same city as its HQ. The outlet said the school would champion _The Epoch Times_ ’ values of “truth and traditional.” They’ve even promised internships and jobs to promising graduates at the outlet and its sister network, _NTD_ , an equally right-wing and conspiratorial television news station.
In August, they released their movie “The Firing Squad,” a drama starring Cuba Gooding Jr. about drug smugglers who find God behind bars. This move into faith-based films aims to tap into a lucrative market, which conservative filmmakers claim counters Hollywood’s “liberal” agenda.
_The New York Times_ has already called _The Epoch Times_ “one of the country’s most powerful digital publishers.” If any of these new ventures succeed, their influence will only grow during a consequential election year.
[**That’s the bad news. The good news is that at COURIER, we’re actively working to counter right-wing misinformation. Online and in swing states, we combat misinformation machines like _The Epoch Times_ where people see them most. The scheme boosted revenues at The Epoch Times by about 410%, and some of those dollars went directly to efforts to re-elect Trump in 2020. While the DOJ has been working on the case, The Epoch Times has been up and running, and most importantly, growing rapidly. #
Friend of Life,

Planned Parenthood just came out with a new video that calls virginity "made up" and a "social construct."

The "educator" in the video tells young people: "It's time to throw away the notion of losing your virginity."

Instead of seeing it as "losing something," Planned Parenthood encourages impressionable teens to experiment sexually because "all of these myths around sex and virginity can be so hurtful and overwhelming."

Planned Parenthood is grooming the next generation for abortion. Promoting risky sexual practices to young people ultimately leads them to broken relationships and more children killed in the womb.

**Will you help fight back against Planned Parenthood 's anti-family, pro-death agenda? I'm asking 50 people to step forward today with a $50 gift to help us put our life-saving videos into classrooms nationwide**. **[https://give.liveaction.org/stop-planned-parenthood-mms/](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=31b8369d8d1c46dd81f5e2fcba0a3a44&_e=lpY1qMCRcemR-2Iw2CwonPVQ2jLjfKokYrt07FI8cPLkPHebP7WU94W_paqu88y_iTR4wlssNjRVZ64IDHmXT9GbcyZ9aAPF4tAU3Z5VSAF2pfHTWYnTLnHhNCH0Y-favlHAmStBemdn5ogd3TCFm_GkvlfaiFLGHVkQ5TR0LMHvHZN6GC5aWlXXsKj8AUUD0OVQdnHE5be8YGo8nZPRjCI2Cl0QQBUh6g2L9SoAMRlDSPgBcmABXq-79cCRWgx0Ymy4VjcOQ9814FRjJFRXQ6EvY0pZ4DVkSeZ16pKbSy7zAXtmCIx6Lqrmtquhk27mnM1vwcDmF_M9k-U5rMKOLvx6cWJKjjRsLuG-W30u8ic%3D)**

Planned Parenthood has continuously pushed egregious and pornographic materials in schools to young kids and teens -- and what do they "teach" these impressionable kids about sex? That disturbing practices are "normal" and "healthy."

In classic Planned Parenthood fashion, irrefutable definitions are warped, and morality is thrown out the window.

Planned Parenthood is the largest provider of sex education in America -- and they teach kids that gender is fluid, deviant sexual practices are normal and healthy, and anything goes, as long as it's consensual.

**We need to protect our children against Planned Parenthood 's deception. This deadly organization should not be the educator of our children. **

Friend of Life, this is why we at Live Action have been creating - and are about to release! - wholesome sex-ed video series for schools across the country to use instead of Planned Parenthood's damaging materials.

We need to spread the truth about loving relationships between men and women and the beauty of procreation before the next generation of parents is convinced by Planned Parenthood's disturbing agenda that leads to abortion.

**But we can 't complete this critical initiative without your support. Your gift of $50 will help us complete the videos and get them into schools across the country. | **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

This man is no stranger to Trump. General Milley was appointed by Trump, personally, as chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff.
For a four-star Army General to use General Milley’s language is extraordinary. Words like “fascist” aren't tossed around lightly in the military, especially from top-ranking Generals.

name: OKGOP
subject: Happy 249th Birthday U.S. Navy
body:
| [ ](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=urG6o0YzHACIJY0G92IOaIOiUFGhm1XQHaiZ59fvCoY&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_happy_249th_birthday_u_s_nav&n=1)
---
Peter -- Today, October 13, we have the honor of celebrating the birthday of the United States Navy, an institution that has protected our nation and its interests for nearly two and a half centuries. Since its establishment in 1775, the Navy has played a pivotal role in securing America's maritime freedom, projecting power across the globe, and ensuring the safety of our nation's citizens both at home and abroad. The U.S. Navy was founded on October 13, 1775, when the Continental Congress authorized the construction of a modest fleet to defend the American colonies from British forces during the Revolutionary War. This small beginning—just two ships—grew into what we now recognize as the world’s most powerful and technologically advanced naval force. The Navy’s mission is clear: to defend our freedom, safeguard the seas, and project American strength and diplomacy wherever needed. Throughout its storied history, the Navy has been involved in pivotal moments that have shaped the course of the nation. From early conflicts during the American Revolution to the triumphs of the War of 1812, the U.S. Navy has always stood ready to protect and defend. The Navy's presence was essential in World War II, where naval battles in the Pacific marked turning points in the global struggle for freedom. Today, the Navy remains a critical component of our national defense, supporting operations that protect our allies, ensure the free flow of global commerce, and counter emerging threats. The Navy’s motto, "Non sibi sed patriae"—"Not for self, but for country"—captures the spirit of service that defines its sailors. It is not just a commitment to defend the homeland, but also a pledge to contribute to global stability. Whether it is through disaster relief, peacekeeping missions, or supporting our allies, the Navy's reach and responsibility span the world. On this day, it is important to also recognize the dedication of the sailors who serve, along with their families who sacrifice so much. Their service embodies the Navy’s core values of honor, courage, and commitment. These values drive them to operate with excellence in every mission, whether defending our shores or providing aid to those in need. As we commemorate this special day, let us express our deep gratitude for the brave men and women of the U.S. Navy who have kept our seas safe for 249 years. Their enduring service continues to be a source of national pride and security. From your friends at the OKGOP,
God Bless

You can also keep up with OKGOP on [Twitter](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=JcrYNQ7dhdufXPgOgJxNGHSsRONv6mnq7ly6aBOUvGVprSj7jfHNOpP70kR_1QLA&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_happy_249th_birthday_u_s_nav&n=3) or [Facebook](https://okgop.nationbuilder.com/r?u=UQNagEd-DqbIXa37T8ODid9mG9NGbq3z9te4_riKc6EaGmrOrRzKc2wAaVTFbzRY&e=48f9f7a040435275f8f9fa993b0a5712&utm_source=okgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2_happy_249th_birthday_u_s_nav&n=4).

| **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Raja for Congress
body:
**Breaking News: Congressman Raja Krishnamoorthi was just endorsed for re-election by the Daily Herald!**

The Daily Herald's editorial board wrote, "Since his first election to Congress in 2016, Schaumburg Democrat Raja Krishnamoorthi has been a hard-working, dedicated representative for the 8th District, and he has steadily grown in skill and in stature over the years. Moderate in temperament and on policy, he emphasizes a commitment to bipartisanship and consistently demonstrates openness to respectful dialogue on issues ranging from immigration to foreign policy and economic affairs, while steadfastly defending his own positions."

The Editorial Board continued, "on immigration, he argues Congress must undertake comprehensive long-term policy reform and, along the way to that, firmly supports the Lankford compromise bill that got stymied by politics earlier this year. On economics, he advocates for spending controls and careful appropriation of resources, and is ranking member of a House panel — the Select Committee on Strategic Competition Between the United States and the Chinese Communist Party — with the ability to influence policy involving our nation’s largest competitor.....He has been aggressive and legislatively successful in the effort to reduce vaping among young people and created the bipartisan Congressional Caucus to End the Youth Vaping Epidemic."

They concluded, "while he is articulate and influential in all these areas and more, Krishnamoorthi also takes pains to tout his staff’s success in responding to problems raised by constituents in the 8th District....He gets our strong endorsement."

Please share this endorsement with your friends and family, and let’s get out the vote for Congressman Raja on or before November 5th!

| | Peter, **Kamala Harris claimed responsibility for the ATF's infringements --every banned gun and part--over the last four years. ** But to make matters even worse, her executive order abuses the new "enhanced background check" process to "red flag" prospective gun buys - resulting in purchase denial and gun confiscation. She uses this new process as a firearm confiscation tool in a 3-step process:
1. An 18-20-year-old adult tries to lawfully buy a gun.
2. The government "red flags" the purchaser.
3. The purchase is denied. Any pre-owned firearms are confiscated.

Peter, the White House just made a _huge mistake_ by reminding gun owners of Kamala's radical, gun-grabbing agenda, with the election a mere month or so away. Gun Owners of America is seizing the opportunity to reach the _more than 10 million_ gun owners and hunters who are unregistered to vote, predominantly in battleground states like Pennslyvania, Texas, and Montana. Fellow Virginia Patriots, What an election season this has been so far! We are seeing record Republican turnout in our localities, and we are all doing our very best to get out the vote with Trump Force 47! As we continue to campaign and recruit voters for President Trump, J.D. Vance, Hung Cao and our Republican Congressional candidates, a hand-full of savvy and creative Republicans from across the Commonwealth are burning the mid-night oil to plan the next Republican Party of Virginia Annual Advance. As many of you know, I wear multiple hats. Today I’m not writing to you as a small business owner, or as the Central Virginia Election Integrity Director for the Trump Campaign, but as the Chair of the Committee on the Advance. 41 years ago, Donald Huffman started a tradition that would stand the test of time. As Republicans, we never retreat - we ADVANCE. Having elections every year here in Our Commonwealth, we never miss a beat, and we never get a break. The most critical thing we can do after an election is immediately begin to prepare for what lies ahead in the next election season. Strategies and data are constantly shifting to accommodate the changing landscape of the political arena. The Advance is a perfect opportunity to hear what lies ahead for 2025.
But don’t let me fool you, it’s not all about break-out sessions and data. We all like to kick up our heels and let off a bit of steam too. That’s why this December we will bringing back Hospitality Suites, The Congressional Brunch, our Awards Luncheon and several surprising and coveted speakers lined up for you, our faithful guests. So, if you have never attended an RPV Annual Advance before, I wholeheartedly implore you to come this year. If you are a veteran attendee, I promise you will not be disappointed. The Advance will be celebrated at: **Kimpton, The Forum Hotel** **540 Massie Road** **Charlottesville, VA 22903** **December 6, 2024,** **through December 8, 2024** The Forum has just undergone a complete renovation, and the food and accommodations are top-notch. It’s affordable too with the RPV discount for room rates of $149/night. So please, consider joining us for a nice weekend away before the holidays to enjoy fellowship, insight, networking and a well-deserved respite after this monumental election season. I look forward to seeing you then and there. Fondly, Jean Gannon, Chairwoman Committee on Arrangements Republican Party of Virginia

clean_body: | | | | Annual Advance Tickets on sale NOW Fellow Virginia Patriots, What an election season this has been so far! We are seeing record Republican turnout in our localities, and we are all doing our very best to get out the vote with Trump Force 47! As we continue to campaign and recruit voters for President Trump, J.D. Vance, Hung Cao and our Republican Congressional candidates, a hand-full of savvy and creative Republicans from across the Commonwealth are burning the mid-night oil to plan the next Republican Party of Virginia Annual Advance. As many of you know, I wear multiple hats. Today I’m not writing to you as a small business owner, or as the Central Virginia Election Integrity Director for the Trump Campaign, but as the Chair of the Committee on the Advance. 41 years ago, Donald Huffman started a tradition that would stand the test of time. As Republicans, we never retreat - we ADVANCE. Having elections every year here in Our Commonwealth, we never miss a beat, and we never get a break. The most critical thing we can do after an election is immediately begin to prepare for what lies ahead in the next election season. Strategies and data are constantly shifting to accommodate the changing landscape of the political arena. The Advance is a perfect opportunity to hear what lies ahead for 2025. But don’t let me fool you, it’s not all about break-out sessions and data. We all like to kick up our heels and let off a bit of steam too. That’s why this December we will bringing back Hospitality Suites, The Congressional Brunch, our Awards Luncheon and several surprising and coveted speakers lined up for you, our faithful guests. So, if you have never attended an RPV Annual Advance before, I wholeheartedly implore you to come this year. If you are a veteran attendee, I promise you will not be disappointed. The Advance will be celebrated at: Kimpton, The Forum Hotel 540 Massie Road Charlottesville, VA 22903 December 6, 2024, through December 8, 2024 The Forum has just undergone a complete renovation, and the food and accommodations are top-notch. It’s affordable too with the RPV discount for room rates of $149/night. So please, consider joining us for a nice weekend away before the holidays to enjoy fellowship, insight, networking and a well-deserved respite after this monumental election season. I look forward to seeing you then and there. Fondly, Jean Gannon, Chairwoman Committee on Arrangements Republican Party of Virginia | | | | | If you have any questions, please feel free to contact info@virginia.gop at any time. Thank you for your continued support, and we hope to see you in December! The Republican Party of Virginia PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY THE REPUBLICAN PARTY OF VIRGINIA ==

body:
Nella News 10.11.2024 | | | | | [](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=64e6660aec&e=780129cd82)
---
| | | | | [](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=796113ccd8&e=780129cd82)

[](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=c0fc575f7d&e=780129cd82)

[](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=ec30f02866&e=780129cd82)
---
| | | |
---
| **The Big Mo...** You can feel it in the air! The air is crisp, the leaves are changing, and our campaign has huge **momentum** as early voting has started throughout New Mexico. We need a new senator for our beautiful state, and **you** have the power to make this change with **your** vote!
---
| **The only way to get a new Senator for New Mexico is to get out and vote.** It’s time to fire Martin Heinrich! [Absentee and limited early voting](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=f81c50a52a&e=780129cd82) started this week! You can vote at your county clerk’s office in person.
Beginning October 19th, you’ll be able to [vote at several locations](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=c424f189e3&e=780129cd82) throughout your county.
---
[](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=d67c61a3db&e=780129cd82)
| **Housing Hoax**[Martin Heinrich, give me a break!](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=affe50e15b&e=780129cd82) At the last minute, just 8 days before early voting starts, he introduced a bill to “solve” our housing crisis! New Mexicans are smarter than that and can see through his smokescreen. Housing costs, like the cost of bread and eggs and everything else, have gone up because of runaway inflation.
---
| | | | | | | | | | [](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=e558c704aa&e=780129cd82)
---
| |
And that inflation was driven by Martin Heinrich’s out-of-control federal spending. It’s time for change.
**We need to fire Martin Heinrich!**
---
| Check out the Journal’s editorial cartoon by John Trevor that perfectly describes Martin Heinrich’s Housing Hoax:
---
[](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=4c27f7d5d4&e=780129cd82)
| **Radical Heinrich** Our borders are overrun, law enforcement is outmatched, and crime and drugs are flooding into New Mexico. And what has Heinrich done? He stood by while a problem became a crisis. Martin Heinrich is too radical for New Mexico.
---
[](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=d81787fc87&e=780129cd82)
[](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=e739f2d408&e=780129cd82)
| _**By The Piñon Post, October 4, 2024**_
U.S. Senator Martin Heinrich launched a new ad today in an apparent attempt to defend his poor record on Fentanyl and border security. His new attempt to muddy his record comes after his opponent, Nella Domenici, launched ads weeks ago pointing out his horrible record and failures as New Mexico’s senior senator.
Instead of taking a strong stand to seal the border, where fentanyl flows like water through river rapids, he has voted dozens of times against funding for the Border Patrol, for border security, or for completion of the barrier on the border.
---
| | | | | | | | | | | He has also been a strong supporter of the Biden-Harris administration’s border policies that led to the flow of the lethal synthetic drug into the country. Despite the failures, he has emphatically endorsed border czar Kamala Harris for the presidency.
---
|
---

| **Four Corners of New Mexico** Nella and her team have put in serious windshield time in our beautiful state, traveling to every corner to meet New Mexicans from all walks of life! From the Navajo reservation near Shiprock, down to Las Cruces, and back up to Española and Farmington, and Old Town in Albuquerque, Nella is criss-crossing New Mexico and listening to your concerns!
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
|
---
| **Diné for Domenici** Nella’s husband Pat joined San Juan and McKinley County volunteers at the Northern Navajo Nation Fair. Navajo citizens enthusiastically welcomed the team. Many elders remembered Nella’s father Senator Pete Domenici, expressing their support of Nella with the Diné Language greeting: _“Ya'at'eeh Senator Domenici.”_
---
[](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=1318f1e4e9&e=780129cd82)
| **88-year-old Democrat votes Nella Domenici for U.S. Senate** And before we leave you, here’s an amazing text we received from one of our supporters. Even [staunch Democrats are voting Nella Domenici](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=63de75328a&e=780129cd82) because they know we need to take New Mexico in a better direction!

|

Friend, I don’t want to alarm you.

I don’t want to stress you out.

But right now, I’m having trouble seeing a path towards our goals. That’s bad, because these goals aren’t arbitrary. They are what we need to raise to win this race. [**So — today, right now, before whatever you have planned later this afternoon, before something else comes up, I’m asking you to split a donation to my campaign and Fight for Reform to help elect state and local Democrats.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/54633?t=7&akid=22291%2E4449941%2EpxSzne) We’re moving a ton of resources right now. We’ve rooted through a ton of data to decide where and when we need to push to reach the undecided voters who are going to decide this election. It’s a good plan. It should work.

But if we don’t raise what we need, we can’t run that play. That strategy falls apart.

We can’t let that happen, because this election is going to be far, far closer than the polls let on. There are doors to knock, phone calls to make, ads that need to get on the air in every county of this state, over just about every hour of every day. [**You are one of my most essential supporters. Right now, I need you if we’re going to have any chance at closing this out the right way. Can you chip in? name: Tamie Wilson
subject: Jordan’s Plan: Gut FEMA, let Americans suffer and die
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
We need to talk about Jim Jordan’s dangerous decision-making – because it’s putting lives at risk.
Hurricane Helene hit multiple states with severe rains and DEADLY flooding – including here in Ohio.
Hurricane Milton came right on Helene’s heels and cut through Florida, leaving more than 20 people dead with more expected.
The destruction has been catastrophic, with entire towns flattened and thousands of lives changed forever. The damage totals in the millions, and FEMA resources are already stretched to their limit.
Being hammered by back-to-back super storms has also taken a huge toll on the mental health of the people most impacted. And how could it not?
Storms like these are completely destabilizing. When something comes along and wipes out your home, your neighborhood, and you can’t even access basic necessities – it completely undermines your sense of safety.
But Jim Jordan doesn’t care about ANY of that. When given the chance to support emergency relief, Jim Jordan voted against FEMA funding right before Hurricane Helene hit.
He voted against the aid that Ohio and the rest of the country desperately needed to recover and rebuild – like he ALWAYS DOES.
And let’s be clear, this isn’t just a one-time vote.
Jordan supports Project 2025, a plan that would gut FEMA even further and slash funding for NOAA and the National Weather Service, and he dismisses their work as “climate propaganda.”
Here we go again: another Jordan conspiracy theory putting lives in danger.
This is why we need your help right now. With just 23 days left, can you chip in $25, $50, or even $100 to ensure we have the resources to kick the science-denying Jordan out of Congress? We’ve got him on the ropes; every dollar goes directly toward reaching voters and exposing his reckless agenda. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241013_fema_link1]
The science is clear: climate change is making extreme weather the new normal, and Americans are paying the price.
We’ve seen what happens when these essential services are underfunded. Now, with hurricanes like Helene and Milton forming more frequently and with increasing intensity, the stakes couldn’t be higher.
Even when they don’t directly strike Ohio, hurricanes like Helene and Milton have far-reaching impacts that threaten our infrastructure and economy.
This is the most important congressional race in the country because Jim Jordan is the biggest cheerleader for Project 2025 in Congress – and he will implement these destructive policies whether Trump wins or not!
We have the chance to not only remove Jim Jordan from office but also ensure that Americans are protected from the climate crisis and future natural disasters.
But we need your help to win.
Contribute today, and together, we can build a future in which FEMA is strengthened, communities get the help they deserve, and we fight the climate crisis head-on. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241013_fema_link2]
Will you join us? Sign up to volunteer here [http://www.tamiewilson.com/volunteer] .
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

Your donations will help Tamie turn out every voter we need to flip this seat and send Jordan packing.

| Dear Fellow American,

I'm reaching out to you with an urgent message. Our nation is at a pivotal moment where the authentic principles that make America great are at risk. While some attempt to distort our history and downplay the values that built this country, we have a crucial opportunity to stand up and preserve our national identity by educating our children. Our educational system increasingly neglects to teach American history accurately. There's a growing effort to marginalize our founding principles, our founding fathers, and our cornerstones of faith, liberty, community, and life. This revisionist history leads to greater division and polarization while diminishing our children's sense of patriotism and civic responsibility.

Through our Celebrate Freedom Week Campaign, you can help ensure that teachers receive the support they need to teach the true story of America. We're sending personalized notes of encouragement from proud patriots like you to teachers who request a free Celebrate Freedom Week box. These boxes are filled with resources to educate K-5 students about the Declaration of Independence, Constitution, Bill of Rights, civic responsibility, and community-centered lessons.

By creating a personalized note for a teacher, you're taking a stand for the importance of historically accurate and patriotic education. You are declaring that while some seek to erase our history, you stand firmly in support of truth, freedom, and the American way of life.

[Create your personalized note for a teacher today to show them your support!](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=e3760a8912114e37a27a475766aea880&_e=-Bub9OmBn-Wtp41efDBODtNBExLlhI7Zn8gScAf4EM7YO5Er3RaVP_n_en9aGLydQXE0Ozavu5py3zWI5a5BMnfrDLnb0Ql1hlOzaUHpuh94WQfkZD9JPQ3D9JuSpVT0ZuHDsMh6ngrjB9PwhNNYJNXV1dFYCHleshQeFfKespDU_DF1bOcBw_Efof2ItwcuLPmqA3v6jAHa_XrJWfAz9rNNLVKl82iguuRdMlqkpaRP2s7ciQ6DB1aN2k0JHxNQnBfnzuJ3yVEFMB74IToWoeNZyP_5JgcOTfawpAJp2f18vD5ECZzYUEi5EFaiZSvSj9dsEJiTV3VWZQFtXdohDOG7_IcPXoxIo5NBGQcLb0Hl9C36dcMsX0nwzZ-g_83t7ne3GBXFZaqBEcG-0ACrMrZgKBoZDaK_YXhF3bUhdrE%3D)

Together, we can encourage teachers and empower the next generation with knowledge and pride in our nation's unique heritage.

We're standing together with you,

Dr. Ben Carson

Derek —

As we enter the final 23-day push to the November election, I wanted to
share a few thoughts on where we stand in our Senate race and the state of
our country.

After witnessing two impeachments, an insurrection, four indictments, and
thirty-four felony counts against Donald Trump, my takeaway is this:

We can have the best Constitution and laws in the world, but none of it
matters if those in power don’t honor their oath of office. If truth and
integrity no longer guide our actions, the foundations of democracy
crumble. Case in point, Donald Trump.

But here's the silver lining: we have the power to change the course of
history for our country. You have that power. As Democrats, we've always
excelled at organizing, our ground game and fighting for what is right.
And when we fight, we win.

We can win our Senate race, keep the Senate blue, flip the House, AND
elect Vice President Kamala Harris to build an economy that works for
everyone, restore reproductive rights, and defend our democracy.

With less than 4 weeks left, we need to pour everything we can into this
election before November 5. I’m confident we can make it happen — but I
need your support to do it.

# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2055%2E135344%2EElGrLl)

Friend --
Like many people who care about the impact elections have on their lives, I am sure your inbox is filled with last-minute requests before the final FEC fundraising deadline of this campaign.
I am invading your inbox as well, apologetically, asking for your help today.
Would you be able to make a contribution to my Senate campaign before our FEC fundraising deadline ends in just a few days? If you have been thinking about donating to our campaign, now would be the perfect time -- especially with my debate tomorrow, as well.
**[https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/FEC-Deadline](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct24.UCjdR-&refcode=em241013-3-900&t=2&akid=2055%2E135344%2EElGrLl)**
I’d really love it if I could earn your support today. Because in just a few days, the public reporting period is over. We need as much momentum as possible because this is the last deadline and this public fundraising report will be looked through with a fine-tooth comb to see how we stack up.
The polls are showing that this Senate race in Michigan is a dead heat with a lot of voters still undecided. That’s who we need to get to. If we fall short of our goal before our FEC deadline ends, it puts us at risk of not being able to reach those voters -- especially in places outside of my current congressional district.
I still need to introduce myself to a lot of undecided people in Michigan, and that introduction could be the difference between winning or losing in November.

subject: Before Trump takes the stage...

body:
Trump lost here by less than 11,000 votes four years ago. He never got over it. This is the state that kicked him out of the White House, and he’ll stop at nothing to take it back.
#

Peter -
I’m writing to ask you to make a contribution — $5 or whatever you can afford — before Trump takes the stage at his rally in Arizona this afternoon.
Here’s the truth:
Trump lost here by less than 11,000 votes four years ago. He never got over it. This is the state that kicked him out of the White House, and he’ll stop at nothing to take it back.
He knows he’s got to defeat me to do that. When he was here in August, he attacked me and rallied his base against me. He said I “shouldn’t even be allowed to run” for Senate. Called me a maniac. When he came back in September he called me “weak” and Kari Lake “strong.”
Now that he’s back in Arizona, we know to expect more.
This is a lot, I know. Trump is putting the pressure on. There’s $150 million in political advertising booked in Arizona this fall, and a ton of that is from Trump and Lake trying to take this state back. I know you don’t want to see him in the White House again, or Kari Lake in the U.S. Senate. We can defeat them, but we’ve got to work together to do it.
So please, I’m humbly asking:
[**Can you make a $5 contribution to my campaign before Trump takes the stage in Arizona this afternoon? I wouldn’t ask if it weren’t so important.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-oct24.6QErJb&refcode=em241013-3-160&t=1&akid=3344%2E734936%2EItc3mc)

name: Sara Jacobs
subject: How to get involved before November:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Hi friends! A lot of folks ask me about the best ways they can really make a difference in this year’s elections – especially from here in California.
The good news is that there is SO much we can do!
First of all, we have several critical House races right here in CA that are must-win districts if we want to flip the House to a Democratic majority. If you’d like to support them, you can click here to split a donation across all of the DCCC’s priority races in California.:
DONATE TO CA HOUSE RACES
But there’s also a huge need for on-the-ground volunteers, so if you can, I’d strongly encourage you to sign up to join the Harris-Walz surge state organizing effort . [https://secure.ngpvan.com/Qy-IE66oC06yuHs1u3NSFA2]
SIGN UP TO VOLUNTEER
Once you sign up, my team will work with the Harris-Walz campaign to make sure you’re plugged into a volunteer opportunity that works for you. And there are so many options – whether that’s hosting a phone bank (in person or virtually) to make calls into high-priority areas, engaging your friends and family in other states in this election, or joining a Carpools for Kamala trip to knock on doors in a battleground state.
The enthusiasm and excitement we’ve been feeling the past few months is thrilling – truly, the vibes are immaculate – but good vibes alone cannot win elections. So we really do need all hands on deck in these final 23 days to do everything we can to support major Democratic victories!
Sign up here – and let’s go WIN! [https://secure.ngpvan.com/Qy-IE66oC06yuHs1u3NSFA2]
Thanks a lot.
-Sara

Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=101324_2&amount=25]
Vox - Project 2025: The myths and the facts [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=101324_2&amount=25]
There's been a lot of talk about the Heritage Foundation's "Project 2025", Team. It's time for the truth.
Project 2025 is a detailed and specific plan for what the next Republican president could ( or in the eyes of some, should ) do with his power, including the preparation needed to put the plan into action. Organized by the Heritage Foundation, a right-wing, dark money, inside-the-beltway, anti-voting think tank , and advised by more than 100 conservative groups, Project 2025 has put forth a 922-page list of policy recommendations, going agency by agency in the federal government.
This is not an unattainable "wish list" -- this is carefully crafted to be a list of things the next president’s appointees really can do , put together by many people who served in top posts under Trump last time and could well do so again. Basically, it’s an attempt to make the second Trump term way more organized and effective than the first.
This is a good place to mention that Project 2025 is also collecting a database of names of conservatives who have already pledged loyalty to Donald Trump and could easily take jobs in his potential second term, willing to start executing this plan on day one.
Are you ready to help us educate voters across the country about this dangerous and anti-democracy plan? Pitch in $25 or whatever you can now >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=101324_2&amount=25]
Project 2025 covers a lot of different things, but basically falls into three buckets:
➜ Expanding the power of the president. Various pieces of the plan attempt to consolidate executive branch power in the hands of the president and his political appointees and away from nonpartisan civil service employees and Congress. For example, Donald Trump himself could be directing voter suppression efforts through the Department of Justice.
➜ Long-term conservative policy priorities. Slashing regulations on businesses, especially in regards to the environment. Ending climate change mitigation efforts. Reducing programs to help the poor, like food programs or educational requirements. Eradicating civil rights protections, including access to the ballot and our ability to vote. The list goes on, but if you've heard it from a conservative politician over the last forty years, it's likely in this plan.
➜ An extreme religious agenda. Further federal restrictions on abortion access. New, possibly expansive restrictions on contraception coverage. Outlawing pornography and imprisoning members of that industry. Banning LGBTQ books in libraries. Rolling back or ending LGBTQ programs in schools.
Project 2025 would fundamentally alter just about every aspect of American life . We must make sure every American is aware of what their vote might mean and how this expansive blueprint would truly impact themselves, their friends, and their family before it is time for them to cast a ballot.
Fuel our efforts to spread the word and educate voters about these dangerous plans with $25 or more today >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=101324_2&amount=25]

Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

**October 13, 2024.**
Today. The day we’re asking you to make your first donation to our movement to elect state Democrats and take a stand against GOP extremism. **$7.**
That’s the amount we’re asking you to chip in today. Your $7 contribution will help launch digital ads, recruit volunteers, and boost our message to voters in these critical final weeks. State legislative races are won by thin margins – your $7 donation will make a difference. **November 5, 2024.**
Election Day. | I’m proposing Employee Homeownership Benefits (E.H.B.) as a key part of the solution. These programs are employer-sponsored and offer financial support to employees to help them buy homes.In places like Denver, where wages aren’t keeping up with rising home prices, E.H.B. programs are game-changers. Peter, As you know, last week Stein/Ware made history by being the first Green campaign to inspire the DNC and their handpicked candidate, Kamala Harris to release an attack ad against Jill. You probably know that they’re whining about Jill allegedly getting help from Republicans. But for all their lies and fear-mongering, it’s Kamala who can’t stop bragging about her 200+ Republican endorsements, including one of the most diabolical warmongers of the 21st century, Dick Cheney.

On a recent appearance on The View, Kamala was asked what she would have done differently than Joe Biden. Her initial response was that she couldn’t think of a single thing she’d have changed; certainly the fates of hundreds of thousands of innocent men, women and children being slaughtered by U.S. bombs in Gaza for over a year didn’t cross her mind. In fact she makes clear that she played a hands-on role in _“most of the decisions that had impact.”_ But later she stated that there’s one thing she does intend to do differently – she’ll appoint a Republican to her cabinet!

If her embrace of the right-wing Republican Party wasn’t obvious enough for voters to grasp, she doubled down on it on Friday when she posted on X of her intention to _“_ _create a bipartisan council of advisors to give feedback on policy and inform (her) administration.”_ Because, she claims:_“Our democracy needs a healthy two-party system.”_

Our democracy isn’t healthy, and neither is the two-party system. A healthy democracy would offer robust choices for the people. Instead the anti-Democratic Party has fought us tooth and nail at every turn – from lawfare to overturn ballot access successes, to withholding our matching funds during a critical moment in our ballot access efforts, to siccing their attack dogs on Jill and Butch, and now sinking millions into a slanderous ad to bully people out of exercising their democratic right to vote for who they want. According to Kamala Harris herself, the biggest difference between her and Joe Biden is that she’s promising to govern even further to the right than he has! [_**Peter, we have just weeks to go to let the voters know that there’s a choice that represents their needs and their values. I’ll explain more in a second, but first, will you make a split donation to my campaign and Fight for Reform to help elect state and local Democrats?**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/54644?t=8&akid=22274%2E4449941%2EE-4yXn) | [DONATE »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/54644?t=9&akid=22274%2E4449941%2EE-4yXn)

Here’s two things I think you should know:

1) Mitch McConnell has made me his top target this cycle, and his super PAC allies are spending nearly $90 million in ads to tear me down. _That’s more outside cash than all of my previous races combined._

2) Polling experts have rated this race a toss-up, which means we need all the resources we can get to build a winning operation.

I won my first Senate race by just 3,562 votes—and this one could be even closer. That’s why it's such bad news that **our fundraising has taken a nosedive in the past 48 hours.**

We have to right the ship _immediately_ , so I’m personally asking: [**Will you split a donation to my campaign today and Fight for Reform to help elect state and local Democrats?**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/54644?t=10&akid=22274%2E4449941%2EE-4yXn)

Fellow American,

This isn’t the news I wanted to share with less than 30 days until Election Day and with early voting currently underway.

According to the latest polling, **_we’re losing._**

subject: Can we explain something to you, Derek?
body:
Trump and his allies will use this information to make last-minute spending decisions.
---
Derek, We’re about to ask you to donate directly to the DNC ahead of our final FEC filing deadline, and to help us reach as many voters as possible in the final days of this election cycle. If that’s all you need to hear, you can use this link to pitch in: [**https://ak.democrats.org/go/October-FEC**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-october-elect-dems-2024?refcode=em_20241013_1842_fr&amount=3&refcode2=1842_22930333_vMS6mU&akid=1842%2E22930333%2EvMS6mU) Otherwise, we hope you’ll give us a chance to explain why your support makes such an impact right now: We are about to file our very last FEC report before Election Day. Our fundraising numbers will once again be public for everyone to see -- and Trump and his allies will use that information to make last-minute spending and outreach decisions of their own. That’s why we’re aiming for an especially strong report to show that Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, and Democrats nationwide are in a powerful position heading toward Election Day. At the same time, we have very real fundraising goals that we need to reach to fund our voter outreach efforts. We can’t do that without your help. Maybe you weren’t considering making your first contribution to the DNC today, but we hope this message has shown you how urgent and meaningful your support is right now. So here comes the part where we ask: [**Can you pitch in $3 ahead of our FEC deadline to help us reach our goals and elect Democrats up and down the ballot?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-october-elect-dems-2024?refcode=em_20241013_1842_fr&amount=3&refcode2=1842_22930333_vMS6mU&akid=1842%2E22930333%2EvMS6mU) _If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly._ | | | **[Donate $3](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-october-elect-dems-2024?express_lane=true&amount=3&refcode=em_20241013_1842_fr&refcode2=1842_22930333_vMS6mU&akid=1842%2E22930333%2EvMS6mU)**

The storm is over, but the effects of Hurricane Helene are still wreaking havoc on thousands of lives. Operation Helo is pivoting to meet the ongoing needs of the people in Western North Carolina.
**The need for helicopter operations has ceased, but the challenges for survivors are far from over.**

Your continued support is critical in this new phase. Many survivors are facing the unimaginable—lost loved ones, destroyed homes, and uncertain futures.
_Operation Helo is here to help ease their burden, but we can’t do it without you._
**Your donation today will help:**
* Provide temporary housing for families who have lost their homes
* Offer funeral assistance to those who tragically lost loved ones
* Support long-term recovery efforts for the hardest-hit communities

These efforts are essential in helping families take the next step toward healing and recovery. Every contribution makes a difference in rebuilding lives after this catastrophic event.

## Updates, Assistance, and Things You Can Do Right Now to Impact Our Upcoming Election
---
### UPDATE: North Carolina Report from the Front Lines
I spent the past week travelling across the most devastated parts of North Carolina. What we saw was ... the best of American resilience. The best of Americans helping Americans.
While we were there, helping in the aftermath of Hurricane Helene, Milton hit Florida, and fires raged across of Wyoming. I believe we’ll continue to experience nationwide traumas and disasters from now through the election. Whether acts of God or man-made nightmares, I think more is in store. Stay strong.
[Emergency election rules](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.UJcOIEsxQ3qr5lEWJDDC4n0IRcOrW5ANbAqB4GIVQ91o4l3f4h5MoZxbmdrYADG-i8k5DVur0LRRgM0loXPtnyZE7kW_G7VIxIUatfcYpMZLV_T4I3rPj-t22AKzWJ7iQbkmdCT69FsXwnAcBcPKRFQzhTSCHUoXbp-Ok8vlldQ0HVpxzqTn21WxiZxy3ndFbTtDUxxTbXA8M2s9mmfwTBa4r86ClXTJ-0DcqW9Od7ltxBHRUykEJG1aTCjIYYFfalKhECM2t8Zks08oAABSVvW_YAwFxniYDK-4FnG2etA/4ak/3cqpu2kFR5m9IQHQuvptDw/h2/h001.e4K8RTJT3xunSF4-02exQaraYdHH2Rbcm9vKWVhR5YE) have been established in North Carolina. Passed by state legislature and implemented by bipartisan consensus, these new rules will allow for the creation of new polling places and other supporting measures, in the most critically damaged areas of Western North Carolina.
True the Vote is working with leaders on the ground to help support voter outreach and messaging efforts. We’ll know more specifics this week. Will keep you posted.

More than 63 million Americans have Latin American/Hispanic heritage and many have Indigenous roots as well. | | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.X6XUC7u8ppFLNtMO_55SZlNseb7gEYIOhm_EWnhzEOZKmTtnV3k2h4V2x_O3H7rdW2az5rgktBwzxQ8Ml9Wgkmv85qW-UsBonL4KRa0bcNqdICU6T3NBDdNIZG7w7wEW5LJ8z6M4qu3BKqTOb-kO7-qh-xOUW3jBa4NBj8FRzP6uMqP2Pz6R7bN9Z4A7oNw47X1p2KRyGV97gekBsitxk3KzLpRJL6CFydym7SkIBU9icP3OnUGPzBtO9YeCb1oqHVsCb2Ne8NEmuRtswWaNTLzfXPvfl2kijN5U4ckaGJo/4ak/LBLgZAcnSMW1KbJDIcBUwA/h0/h001.5G5FfKZiWfQMfht9Z6OxtHHlkPvfKFOydae0G6WC7v4)

Friend, **This month is Hispanic Heritage Month in the United States, a time to celebrate and honor the more than 63 million Americans with Latin American/Hispanic heritage**. I grew up in Southwest Detroit, home to one of the largest Latin American communities in Michigan. I still remember going to the Detroit Hispanic Development Corporation as a young organizer, which helped shape my values as a justice seeker. This is why I am hoping you can help shape the next generation of young organizers through your support of the Detroit Hispanic Development Corporation. **The Detroit Hispanic Development Corporation (DHDC) is rooted in the vibrant culture of Detroit’s Latin American community, supporting over 5,000 youth and adults annually** with life-changing opportunities for self-empowerment and self-determination, education, workforce development, financial literacy, and more. As part of providing high-quality and culturally competent services for the community, over 80% of DHDC’s staff members were born and raised in Southwest Detroit, and 40% of staff are graduates of DHDC’s programs. Right now [the Detroit Hispanic Development Corporation needs funding support for**** after-school and summer youth programs](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoSBoJrCjv5kOU99oGZgblxC8bGJ_2gQCiqXfNu12_fT6Iitg1hHOc0lEJPhMQ99Mv1p6xvzcYADTtB26BaTK9oqSkIId5BWoGVOcaVlnM6zsF_UQ64YoSKJ3bbynUoXJ7xM2Dg1evg8lnudHP-qtUmEDg9p6i8D5Xa8iIdjb1ocK95QhqRdrw9ue8p60GIS0-M3-m5HAfnd3O0cjwooSD25L1dK08ll2b-B5b_aBqFOkhB27gN_TAi-HceMwMu5pm9ttEDbVIiwkxBYYPbnZmDu5x8wZtcQEe3DTKXOzmE9_02OzLOjhpWqpbviCR4xAFTHIpCG366GRGX0IGlxKw3E/4ak/LBLgZAcnSMW1KbJDIcBUwA/h1/h001.242DqR5-f3nU7Eo-dkoxh3kFcI2_W09jcjNOS20vY60), which engage K-12 students with hands-on experience and training in applied math and science, 3D design and printing, computer programing, robotics, electronics and engineering, marketing, music and video production, and graphic design. **Several professional engineers mentor youth throughout the year** , and some young people have already gone on to attain a degree in engineering and secure steady employment. Through these programs, **the Detroit Hispanic Development Corporation has now helped to develop robotics programs in every high school in Southwest Detroit**. They’re expanding to middle and elementary schools, helping more students innovate and apply creative thinking and design skills that will help them with economic security in adulthood.**This kind of investment is particularly important for communities that have been too often left behind** , and it’s just one piece of the Detroit Hispanic Development Corporation’s service in the community. DHDC also provides technical support and small re-grants to other Latin American-led organizations doing advocacy and community organizing work across Michigan. [**Can you donate directly to the Detroit Hispanic Development Corporation today, in honor of Hispanic Heritage Month? Your support helps invest in thousands of young people and their families to see themselves as agents of change and self-determination.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoSBoJrCjv5kOU99oGZgblxC8bGJ_2gQCiqXfNu12_fT6Iitg1hHOc0lEJPhMQ99Mv1p6xvzcYADTtB26BaTK9oqSkIId5BWoGVOcaVlnM6zs-eDdAkiQcoJz0k0rhnuFA_OyZxUoi_p8NXrnRCgcB6k2zxNbVhdCqMhvbZHdJsYf9L3NLFt77YXsUXS_xkwZIcqD-64sYf4tKxjHSoAB_wJaMzNl0I36yD3KuReXnDnbQ01Nc5QabmMaXnHhzrnxwdX1eDToAllD_INfpS0g0eMlGNqO50o3EklLbc7HiREJQPbIL-Q-kokLxQW8BoUlWG2f-Z1AS6gzC7wPjELPiiM/4ak/LBLgZAcnSMW1KbJDIcBUwA/h2/h001.t56sEWaIlaTpboNInuM3rvJNphIpdPcDx5eT1ARnLwU) | [Yes, I'll donate now!](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoSBoJrCjv5kOU99oGZgblxC8bGJ_2gQCiqXfNu12_fT6Iitg1hHOc0lEJPhMQ99Mv1p6xvzcYADTtB26BaTK9oqSkIId5BWoGVOcaVlnM6zs_wIoB_p-O7ElLX-_HnxX0Jtp3NPH442srds0UmvE341WfAqJCuW1NPRoyIfsnnSLpByJ6KdWlY8narizi1DuutUyJgXnSNVZV8P8_sJKS0VVO7LhibUVRjUmjxEyJut8xXbO37ErtWqBwsM_dE-orjCUH-d8xBk4SMYhyhCAbHKSx2rJMOTHsQeLLQTpYg08gCAscUgufTIR0EfUzWKRiD6Pk5rn2uifCh8ltJoUaSc/4ak/LBLgZAcnSMW1KbJDIcBUwA/h3/h001.q2WMw6bN6ue-HaQvviXatjsk9ugdLL5GFYzHYE-QU8w)

Our opponent is working harder than ever, but thanks to your unwavering support, we are keeping the momentum strong and pushing forward.This past week was a powerful one for our campaign. I was honored to attend a special event at Johnson C. Smith University as part of our ongoing HBCU outreach. Engaging with students and faculty there was inspiring, and it reminded me just how important it is to ensure that every voice is heard in our district.In addition, our recent success at the Carolinas AAPI Business Alliance event has opened new doors. I was also thrilled to attend as the only Republican candidate at the 25th Anniversary Gala for the Carolinas Asian American Chamber of Commerce. Connecting with leaders from our diverse communities reinforces my commitment to representing every voice in our district, from entrepreneurs to educators and everything in between.As we come down to the wire, it’s we must finish this campaign strong. Our vision for a better future is within reach, but we need your help to cross the finish line.We’re up against a well-funded opponent, and your contributions are what give us the edge. Whether it’s $25, $50, or $100, every donation makes a direct impact on our ability to connect with voters and share our message of positive change for this district and our nation.Join us in this final push to victory.
